tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mdzod kyi gnas gnyis pa'i ṭīkka bzhugs/

gnyis pa yul can dbang po'i rab dbye bshad pa la/ dbang po nyer gnyis kyi rang bzhin/ 'dus byas kyi chos rnams kyi skye tshul/ rgyu rkyen 'bras bu'i 'byung tshul gyi sgo nas bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ dbang por 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ dbang po'i grangs nges/ ngo bo/ rab dbye dang bzhi/ dang po la/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs dang*/ mdo sde pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ lnga po rnams ni don bzhi la/ dbang byed bzhi rnams gnyis la lo lnga dang brgyad po de rnams ni/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang la/ zhes byung*/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mig sogs dbang po lnga po rnams ni chos can/ don bzhi bzhi la dbang byed pa yin te/ lus bsrung ba/ lus mdzes pa/ yul la dmigs pa/ rang 'bras rnam shes skyed pa ste bzhi bzhi rang sang byed pas na dbang po zhes brjod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ mig gis gnod byed mthong nas lus srung*/ rna bas de'i sgra thos nas srung*/ sna lce lus gsum gyis kham zas la longs spyod pa'i sgo nas lus rgyas par byas pa'i sgo nas srung bar byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ dbang po de dag lus la ldan na mdzes shing mi ldan na mi mdzes pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ dbang po lnga po de dag gis rang rang gi yul gzugs sgra sogs la dmigs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa grub ste/ lnga po des rang rang gi rnam shes kyi bdag rkyen byed pa la dbang byed pa'i phyir/ pho mo'i dbang po gnyis dang srog yid gnyis te bzhi rnams chos can/ don gnyis gnyis la dbang byed pa yin te/ dang po rang gang la ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag de nyid phor mtshon zhing*/ skad gzengs mtho ba sogs la dbang byed/ gnyis pas mor mtshon zhing skad phra ba sogs la dbang byed/ gsum pas dbang po'i rigs 'dra snga ma las phyi ma 'byung ba dang*/ byung ba gnas par byang*/ bzhi pas snga ma nas 'di dang 'di nas phyi mar nying mtshams sbyor ba sogs la dbang byed pa'i phyir/

lo zhes smros pa la chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ bye smra'i 'dod pa la ma rangs pa'i dgag pa 'phen pa'i phyir te/ dbang po de dag gi don bshad tshul bye smra'i der ma 'dus pa'i phyir/ tshor ba bde sdug gnyis dang yid bde mi bde gnyis dang btang snyoms kyi dbang po lnga chos can/ dbang po zhes bya ste/ kun nas nyon mongs pa la dbang byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bde ba la chags/ sdug bsngal la khro/ btang snyoms las ni ma rig pa skyed pa'i phyir/ dad pa brtson 'grus dran pa ting nge 'dzin shes rab kyi dbang po lnga dang*/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po sogs gsum ste brgyad po de rnams ni chos can/ dbang po zhes bya ba ste/ rnam byang phyogs la dbang byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang gi mi mthun phyogs mgo mnon cing*/ rtogs pa gong 'phel du byed pa la dbang byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig /pho thams cad pho dbang gis phor mtshon zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ gzugs khams pa'i gang zag la pho mo'i dbye ba yod kyang*/ pho mo'i dbang po de med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i pho mo ni skad gdangs mtho mi mtho dang*/ nu ma'i khyad par gyis 'jog pa'i phyir/ kha cig /pho'i dbang po ldan pa'i gang zag yin na/ pho yin pas khyab zer na/ mtshan gnyis pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ pho mo gnyis ka'i dbang po dang ldan pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos can de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mo yin par thal/ mo dbang dang ldan pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa don gyis song*/ 'dod na/ pho mo gnyis ka yin par thal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang gi don dang thams cad la/ /dmigs par dbang byed phyir dbang drug /mo ni pho nyid la dbang phyir/ /lus las mo dang pho dbang dag /ris gnas kun nas nyon mongs dang*/ /rnam par byang la dbang byed phyir/ /srog dang tshor ba rnams dang ni/ /dad sogs dbang po lngar 'dod do/

/mya ngan 'das sogs gong nas gong*/ /'thob pa la ni dbang byed phyir/ /kun shes byed dang kun shes dang*/ /de bzhin kun shes ldan dbang po/ /zhes byung*/ mig sogs dbang po rnams chos can/ khyod la dbang po zhes bya ste/ khyod drug gi dang po lngas rang gi gzung don gzugs sogs lnga dang*/ drug pa yid kyis chos thams cad la dmigs par byed pa la dbang byed pas na de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ pho mo'i dbang po gnyis chos can/ rang gi rang bzhin la dbang byed pas dbang po zhes bya ste/ mo'i rang bzhin nga ro zhen pa dang spyod pa pho la sems pa nyid dang*/ pho'i rang bzhin de las ldog pa nyid la dbang byed pas na de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis chos can/ lus dbang gi cha shas yin te/ lus kyi cha shas las grub pa'i mo dang pho'i dbang po dag yin pa'i phyir/ srog gi dbang po chos can/ dbang po zhes bya ste/ sems can gyi phung po'i rigs 'dra gnas pa la dbang byed pa'i phyir/ tshor ba'i dbang po rnams dang*/ dad sogs kyi dbang po lnga chos can/ dbang po zhes bya ste/ rim bzhin kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba la dbang byed par 'dod pa'i phyir/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po dang*/ kun shes pa'i dbang po dang*/ de bzhin du kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po rnams chos can/ dbang po zhes bya ste/ snga mas phyi ma dang lhag med myang 'das kyi bar gong nas gong du 'thob pa la dbang byed cing*/ sogs te mthong sgom gyi spang bya rim gyis spong ba dang*/ spangs pa la'ang dbang byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grangs nges la/ bye brag smra ba dang*/ mdo sde pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ sems kyi rten dang de'i bye brag /gnas dang kun nas nyon mongs nyid/ /tshogs dang rnam byang ji snyed pa/ /dbang po dag kyang de snyed du/ /zhes byung*/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ grangs can sogs na re/ dbang po nyer gnyis su grangs ma nges par thal/

ngag dang rkang lag dang 'doms dang phongs kyi dbang po yang yod pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ skyon de mi 'jug par thal/ sems can gyi lus sems kyi khyad par gyi rten byed pa'i cha nas rgyu ji snyed yod pa de dag dang mthun par dbang po'i grangs dag kyang de snyed du bzhag pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sems rnam shes kyi rten nam gzhi byed pa'i cha nas mig sogs dbang po drug bzhag /sems can de'i pho mo'i bye brag 'byed pa'i cha nas pho mo'i dbang po gnyis bzhag /sems can gyi phung po'i rigs rgyun gnas par byed pa'i cha nas srog gi dbang po bzhag /sems can kun nas nyon mongs pa la spyod cing dbang byed pa'i cha nas tshor ba'i dbang po lnga ste nyon mongs phyogs kyi dbang po bcu bzhi bzhag la/ rnam byang gi rgyu tshogs pa'i dbang du byas nas dad sogs dbang po lnga dang*/ rnam par byang ba'i ngo bor skyes shing dbang byed pa dang ldan pa'i cha nas dri med kyi dbang po gsum bzhag cing*/ 'khor ba'i 'jug rim gyi dbang gis bcu bzhi dang*/ ldog rim gyi dbang gis brgyad bzhag pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig /dbang po nyer gnyis su grangs ma nges par thal/ ngag gi dbang po sogs kyis dbang po'i bya ba byed nus pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ngag gis gtam smra/ lag pas len 'jog /rkang pas 'gro 'dug /'doms kyis dga' mgur/ phongs kyis rtug pa 'byin pa la dbang byed pa'i phyir zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ re re nas ma nges pa'i phyir/ der thal/ tshig smra ba slob pa dang kun slong lta bu la ltos/ srog chags 'ga'i kha dang rkang pas kyang 'degs 'jog byed/ sbrul dang nya sogs la rkang lag med kyang 'gro 'ong byed/ pha wang gi kha nas kyang rtug pa 'byin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /nyan thos kyi tshogs sbyor na dri med kyi dbang po gsum ka yod zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ dri med dbang po dang po kun shes byed pa'i dbang po la mthong lam gyis khyab/

gnyis pa kun shes pa'i dbang po la sgom lam gyis khyab/ gsum pa kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po la mi slob lam gyis khyab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mdo sde pa'i lugs ni/ yang na 'jug pa'i rten dang ni/ /skye dang gnas dang nyer spyod las/ /bcu bzhi de bzhin ldog pa la/ /dbang po rnams ni gzhan yin no/ /zhes byung*/ yang na dbang po nyer gnyis su grangs nges pa yin te/ 'khor bar 'jug pa'i rten gyi dbang du byas nas mig sogs dbang po drug dang*/ 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu byed pa'i cha nas pho mo'i dbang po gnyis dang*/ ris mthun gnas pa'i dbang du byas nas srog gi dbang po dang*/ yum nye bar longs spyod pa'i cha nas tshor ba'i dbang po lnga ste bcu bzhi bzhag /de bzhin du de las ldog pa'i dbang du byas nas dbang po gzhan phye ma brgyad rnams bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ngo bo la/ tshor ba'i dbang po lnga bshad pa dang*/ dri med kyi dbang po gsum bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ lus tshor sim pa ma yin gang*/ /sdug bsngal dpa' bo'o sems pa ni/ /bde ba'o bsam gtan gsum pa na/ /sems kyi de ni bde dbang po/ /gzhan ni de yid bde ba yin/ /sems kyi sim pa ma yin pa/ /yid mi bde ba'o btang snyoms ni/ /bar ma'o gnyis ka'i mi gtogs phyir/ /zhes byung*/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ tshor ba la lngar phye ba'i tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi dbang po'i mtshan nyid yod de/ sim pa ste bde ba ma yin par gdung bar nyams su myong ba'i lus tshor de de yin pa'i phyir/ tshor ba bde ba'i dbang po'i mtshan nyid yod de/ sim par nyams su myong ba'i lus tshor dang bsam gtan gsum pa na yod pa'i sems kyi tshor ba bde ba gang rung gis bsdus pa'i sim pa'i tshor ba de ni de yin pa'i phyir/ tshor ba yid bde ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/ bsam gtan gsum pa las gzhan pa'i sim par myong ba'i sems tshor de de yin pa'i phyir/

tshor ba yid mi bde ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/ sim pa ma yin par gdung bar nyams su myong ba'i sems kyi tshor ba de de yin pa'i phyir/ tshor ba btang snyoms kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ sim gdung bar ma nyams su myong ba'i tshor ba de de yin pa'i phyir te/ de ni bde sdug gnyis kar mi gtogs par myong ba'i yul can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi dbang po yin na/ tshor ba la lngar phye ba'i sdug bsngal gyi dbang po yin pas khyab zer na/ tshor ba yid mi bde ba'i dbang po chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ chos can de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lus tshor yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ phyi tshor yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ lus tshor phyi tshor dbang shes su gyur pa'i tshor ba rnams don gcig yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na mi 'thad par thal/ nang gi tshor ba yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ yid kyi tshor ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ yid kyi tshor ba/ nang gi tshor ba/ yid shes su gyur pa'i tshor ba rnams don gcig pa'i phyir/ kha cig /tshor ba bde ba'i dbang po yin na/ tshor ba la lngar phye ba'i bde ba'i dbang po yin pas khyab zer na/ tshor ba yid bde ba'i dbang po chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ tshor ba la gsum du phye ba'i tshor ba bde ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na mi 'thad par thal/ chos can de yin pa'i phyir khyab ste/ de lngar phye ba'i tshor ba bde ba gtso bor lus tshor la 'jog pa'i phyir/ kha cig /dad sogs dbang po lnga po gang rung la lam gyi khyab zer na/ lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi dad pa'i dbang po chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ der dkon mchog dang las 'bras dang bden bzhi'i blang dor la dad cing 'jug pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na sla'o/ /gnyis pa dri med kyi dbang po ni/ mthong sgom mi slob lam la dgu / gsum yin zhes byung*/

theg pa gsum ga'i mthong lam chos can/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po yin te/ bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ mthong lam chos can/ khyod la dbye na dgu yod de/ rang gi ngo bor gyur pa'i dad sogs dbang po lnga dang*/ yid dang tshor ba bde ba dang yid bde btang snyoms dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ sgom lam rnams chos can/ kun shes pa'i dbang po yin te/ zag med kyi rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na dgu yod de/ sngar ltar dgu yod pa'i phyir/ mi slob lam rnams chos can/ kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po yin te/ zad mi skye shes pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo ldan pa'i zag med kyi shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na dgu yod de/ sngar ltar yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa dbang po'i dbye ba la/ dbang po'i dbye ba dngos/ de rnyed gtong gi tshul/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu dbang po dus 'thob tshul/ dbang po ldan tshul bzhi/ dang po la/ nyis tshan dang*/ sum tshan gyi dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ zag pa dang bcas ma bcas kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ rnam smin yin min gyi sgo nas/ rnam smin dang bcas ma bcas kyi sgo nas dbye ba gsum/ dang po ni/ gsum ni dri ma med/ /gzugs can srog dang sdug bsngal dag/zag dang bcas pa dgu rnam gnyis/ zhes byung*/ bshad ma thag pa'i kun shes kyi dbang po gsum chos can/ zag med kho na yin te/ dri med kyi dbang po yin pa'i phyir/ dbang po gzugs can bdun dang srog dang sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde ba dang dgu po dag chos can/ zag pa dang bcas pa kho na yin te/ lam bden du ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ dad sogs dbang po lnga/ tshor ba bde ba/ yid bde/ btang snyoms/ yid dbang dang dgu chos can/ zag bcas yin min gyis rnam pa gnyis yod de/ lam bden gyis bsdus ma bsdus gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ srog ni rnam smin bcu gnyis gnyis/ /tha ma brgyad dang yid mi bde/

/ma gtogs pa ste zhes byung*/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ dbang po nyer gnyis la rnam smin yin min gyi khyad par yod de/ srog ni rnam smin kho na yin la/ dad sogs lnga dang dri med gsum ste tha ma brgyad dang yid mi bde ba rnams rnam smin ma yin pa kho na yin zhing*/ de rnams ma gtogs pa dbang po gzugs can bdun/ tshor ba gzhan bzhi dang yid dbang dang bcu gnyis la rnam smin yin min gnyis ka yod pa'i phyir/ srog ni rnam smin kho na yin te/ bde 'gro dang ngan 'gro'i srog ni dge mi dge'i rnam smin nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dad sogs brgyad chos can/ rnam smin ma yin te/ dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ yid mi bde ba chos can/ rnam smin ma yin te/ khyod la dge mi dge gnyis 'byung ba'i phyir te/ sdig pas yid mi bde ba dge ba dang*/ zhe sdang gis yid mi bde ba mi dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ mig rna ba sna lce lus pho mo'i dbang po bdun la rnam smin yin min gnyis yod de/ de bdun las kyis byung ba ni rnam smin dang*/ rgyas byung rnams ni rnam smin ma yin pa'i phyir/ tshor ba yid bde ba las gzhan bzhi dang yid dbang dang lnga la rnam smin yin min gnyis ka yod de/ de rnams kyi dge ba dang nyon mongs can sogs rnam smin ma yin la/ las skyes 'ga' zhig ni rnam smin yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rnam smin ni lung ma bstan yin yang 'bad rtsol la mi bltos shing*/ dge mi dge dang 'bad pas bsgrub dgos pa'i lung ma bstan rnams rnam smin ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig/srog la rnam smin gyis ma khyab par thal/ 'byung ba rgyas pa las byung ba'i srog ni rnam smin ma yin par 'dod pa sogs du ma yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags der thal/ btsun pa dbyangs sgrogs rjes 'brang dang bcas pas de ltar 'dod pa'i phyir/ kha cigatshe 'di'i phung po lnga rnam smin yin par thal/

tshe 'di'i skye ba blangs pa'i cha dang lus grub pa'ang rnam smin yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de gang rung yin na/ rnam smin yin dgos par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab ste/ de la rnam smin gyi 'gyur ba yin la/ rnam smin ma yin pa yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de las phyis rgyas byung du gyur pa yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ de gcig ni/ rnam par smin bcas bcu rnam gnyis/ /yid dang tshor gzhan dad la sogs/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ dbang po nyer gnyis la rnam par smin pa bcas ma bcas yin min gnyis yod de/ yid mi bde ba de gcig pu ni 'bras bu rnam smin dang bcas la/ yid dbang dang tshor ba gzhan bzhi dad pa la sogs pa'i dbang po lnga ste bcu la rnam smin dang bcas ma bcas rnams pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma der thal/ dad sogs zag bcas rnam smin dang bcas shing*/ zag med rnams rnam smin dang ma bcas la/ yid dang tshor ba gzhan bzhi dge mi dge ni rnam smin dang bcas shing*/ de las gzhan rnam smin dang ma bcas pa'i phyir/ lhag ma rnams la rnam smin med de/ srog gi dbang po dang gzugs can bdun ni lung ma bstan yin pas rnam smin med la/ dri med gsum ni zag med yin pas rnam smin med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dge sogs gsum dang*/ khams gsum dang*/ mthong spang sogs gsum gyi sgo nas dbye ba gsum/ dang po ni/ dge ba brgyad yid mi bde ba/ /rnam gnyis yid dang tshor gzhan ni/ /rnam gsum gzhan ni rnam pa gcig/ces byung*/ shes bya chos can/ dbang po de las gcig tu dge ba yin pa yod de/ rnam byang gi dbang po brgyad po de de yin pa'i phyir/ yid mi bde ba chos can/ dge mi dge rnam pa gnyis yod de/ dge ba byas pa la yid mi bde ba mi dge ba dang*/ mi dge ba byas pa la yid mi bde ba dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ yid dang tshor ba gzhan bzhi chos can/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan rnam pa gsum yod de/

dge sogs gsum gyi sems dang mtshungs ldan gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan dbang po gzugs can bdun dang srog dbang dang brgyad chos can/ rnam pa gcig tu lung ma bstan yin te/ dge mi dge gang rung gis bsdus pa ma yin pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dri med ma gtogs 'dod par gtogs/ /pho mo'i dbang dang sdug bsngal dag/ma gtogs gzugs gtogs gzugs can dang*/ /bde ba'ang ma gtogs gzugs med gtogs/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ 'dod khams kyi sar gtogs bcu dgu yod de/ dri med kyi dbang po gsum po ma gtogs gzhan bcu dgu po rnams de ltar yin pa'i phyir/ dbang po nyer gnyis po chos can/ khyod las gzugs kyi sar gtogs pa bco lnga yod de/ sngar gyi bcu dgu las pho mo'i dbang po dang*/ tshor ba sdug bsngal dang*/ yid mi bde ba dag ste bzhi ma gtogs pa'i bco lnga po de de yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs med kyi sar gtogs brgyad yod de/ dbang po gzugs can bdun dang bde mi bde sogs bzhi dang dri med gsum ma gtogs/ srog yid btang snyoms gsum dang dad sogs lnga ste brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ yid dang tshor ba gsum rnam gsum/ /gnyis kyis spang bya yid min te/ /dgu ni sgom pas lnga po ni/ /spang bar bya min yang gsum min/ /zhes byung*/ yid dang tshor ba bde ba yid bde btang snyoms gsum po chos can/ khyod la mthong spang sgom spang spang bya min pa rnam pa gsum ga'i cha yod de/ mthong spang dang mtshungs ldan rnams mthong spang yin la/ de las gzhan pa'i zag bcas rnams sgom spang dang*/ zag med rnams spang bya ma yin pa'i phyir/ tshor ba yid mi bde ba chos can/ khyod la mthong sgom gnyis kyis spang bar bya ba'i cha gnyis yod de/ mthong spang dang mtshungs ldan yin min gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dbang po gzugs can bdun dang srog dang tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi dbang po dgu chos can/

sgom pas spang par bya ba yin te/ mthong spang ma yin pa'i zag bcas yin pa'i phyir/ dad sogs lnga po chos can/ sgom pas spang bar bya ba ma yin pa yang yod la de'i spang bya yin pa yang yod de/ zag med spang bya min yang zag bcas sgom spang yin pa'i phyir/ dri med kyi dbang po gsum chos can/ spang bya min par nges te/ zag med yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rnyed gtor gi tshul la/ rnyed pa'i tshul dang*/ gtor ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ 'dod pa dang*/ gong ma'i dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mngal skyes dang*/ rdzus skyes kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis te/ 'dod par dang por rnam smin gnyis/ /rnyed de rdzus te skye bas min/ /de las drug gam bdun nam brgyad/ /ces byung*/ shes bya chos can/ 'dod par mngal skyes sogs gsum skye ba'i tshe dang por rnam smin gyi dbang po du zhig rnyed tshul yod de/ lus srog gi dbang po gsar du rnyed la/ de'i tshe dad sogs dang yid dang btang snyoms sogs 'ga' zhing rnyed kyang de rnams ni rnam smin ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'dod par rdzus te skye bas ni rnam smin srog lus gnyis kho na rnyed pa ma yin te/ bskal pa dang po'i mi ltar mtshan gnyis ka med na rnam smin du gyur pa'i mig sogs lnga dang srog dang drug/'dod lha lta bus de las mig sogs drug dang pho mo'i dbang po gang rung dang bdun/ ngan 'gro lta bus mig sogs drug dang mtshan gnyis bsnan nas brgyad rnyed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs na drug go gong mar gcig/zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ gzugs su nying mtshams sbyor ba'i dang por dbang po drug rnyed de/ mig sogs lnga dang srog dang drug rnyed pa'i phyir/ de'i gong ma gzugs med du mang po cig car du rnyed pa ma yin te/ rnam smin srog skyes gcig pu rnyed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzugs med khams na gzugs can gyi dbang po rnams med pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la/ nyon mongs can lung ma bstan gyi gtong tshul dang*/ dge sems can gyi gtong tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ khams gong ma dang*/ 'dod khams kyi gtong tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs med dag tu 'chi ba ni/ /srog dang yid dang btang snyoms nyid/ /'gag par 'gyur ro gzugs na brgyad/ / ces byung*/ shes bya chos can/ gzugs med dag tu 'chi ba'i tshe na dbang po du zhug gcig car du gtong tshul yod de/ srog dang yid dang btang snyoms gsum nyid cig car du 'gag par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gzugs khams su gtong tshul yod de/ snga ma gsum dang mig sogs lnga ste brgyad cig car 'gag par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ der thal/ rdzus skyes la dbang po lnga tshang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dod par bcu 'am dgu 'am brgyad/ rim gyis 'chi bdag la bzhi/ zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ 'dod par mtshan gnyis pa cig car 'chi ba'i tshe dbang po du zhig 'gag tshul yod de/ mig sogs lnga dang srog yid btang snyoms gsum pho mo'i dbang po gnyis te bcu cig car gtong ba'i phyir/ mtshan gcig pa chos can/ khyod kyis dbang po gtong tshul yod de/ snga ma brgyad kyi steng pho mo'i dbang po gang rung zhig dang bcas pa dgu cig car gtong ba'i phyir/ 'dod khams pa rim gyis 'chi ba dag la chos can/ gtong tshul yod de/ lus srog yid btang snyoms bzhi cig car gtong ba'i phyir/ der thal/ de dag so sor phral nas mi 'chi ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dge la thams cad dag dang lnga/ zhes byung*/ dge sems can chos can/ khyod 'chi ba'i tshe snga ma las mang ste/ gong du bshad pa ltar 'gag pa'i gnas skabs thams cad du de dag dang dad sogs dbang po lnga cig car 'gag dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'bras bu tha ma gnyis dgus 'thong*/ /gnyis ni bdun dang brgyad dang dgus/ /bcu gcig dag gis dgra bcom nyid/ /'ga' zhig srid phyir bshad pa yin/ /zhes byung*/ 'bras bu tha ma snga phyi gnyis las rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu chos can/

zag med kyi dbang po dgus 'thob ste/ lam rjes shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dad sogs dbang po lnga/ yid dbang*/ btang snyoms/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po ste brgyad dang*/ lam rjes shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i kun shes pa'i dbang po dang dgus thob pa'i phy-ir/ phyi ma dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu chos can/ dbang po dgus thob ste/ sgom lam rdo rje lta bu'i ngo bor gyur pa'i dad sogs lnga dang tshor ba bde ba yid dbang yid bde btang snyoms gsum gang rung*/ kun shes pa'i dbang po ste brgyad dang*/ mi slob lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po dang dgus thob pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu bar pa gnyis ni chos can/ thob tshul yod de/ dbang po bdun dang brgyad dang dgus thob pa gsum yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyis thob par byed na dad sogs lnga dang mi lcogs med pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i yid dang btang snyoms bdun gyis thob/ mthar gyis pa lhag mthong la shas cher spyad pa yin na/ dad sogs dang me lcags med pa'i yid dang tshor ba btang snyoms te bdun dang kun shes pa'i dbang po dang brgyad kyis thob/ chags bral gyi 'bras bu ni rgyun zhugs ltar mthong lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dbang po brgyad dang lam rjes shes dang dgus thob pa'i phyir/ rab tu byed par dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu dbang po bcu gcig dag gis thob par bshad pa dang mi 'gal te/ des dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu nyid 'gal zhig thob srid pa la dgongs nas bshad pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ldan tshul la/ nges ldan dang*/ srid ldan gnyis/ dang po la/ phan tshun nges ldan dang*/ dbang po gzhan nges ldan gyi tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ btang snyoms dang ni srog dang ni/ /yid dang ldan pa nges ldan gsum/ /zhes byung*/ btang snyoms dang ni srog dang yid dbang gsum chos can/ nges ldan yin te/ phan tshun nges ldan yin pa'i phyir der thal gang rung gcig dang ldan na gzhan gnyis kyang ldan par nges pa'i phyir/

de chos can/ khyab pa'i nges ldan yin te/ khams gsum gyi 'gro ba thams cad la khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de gsum dang mi ldan pa'i gang zag mi srid pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bde lus ldan la bzhi dag dang*/ /mig sogs ldan la lnga dang ldan/ /yid bde ldan yang sdug bsngal ldan/ /bdun dang mo yi dbang sogs ldan/ /brgyad dang kun shes ldan pa yi/ /dbang po ldan la bcu gcig ldan/ /kun shes byed pa'i dbang ldan la/ /bcu gsum dag dang ldan pa yin/ /zhes byung*/ bde ba chos can/ khyod dang ldan na dbang po bzhi dag dang ldan pas khyab ste/ nges ldan gsum gyi steng du bde ba dang bzhi ldan pa'i phyir/ lus dbang chos can/ khyod dang ldan na bzhi dag dang ldan te/ nges ldan gsum dang khyod dang bcas bzhi ldan pa'i phyir/ mig sogs dbang po lnga chos can/ khyod so so dang ldan na lnga dang ldan te/ nges ldan gsum dang lus dang bzhi'i steng du khyod gang rung gcig ste lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir/ yid bde chos can/ khyod dang ldan na yang lnga dang ldan te/ bde ba dang yid bde ba ste lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal gyi dbang po chos can/ khyod dang ldan na dbang po bdun dang ldan te/ nges ldan gsum/ sdug bsngal bde ba yin bde ba btang snyoms bcas ldan pa'i phyir/ mo yi dbang po dang sogs te pho'i dbang po yid mi bde dang dad sogs gang rung ste bzhi dang ldan na brgyad dang ldan te/ snga ma bdun dang pho mo'i dbang po gang rung ste brgyad dang ldan pa dang*/ yid mi bde dang*/ dad sogs gang rung dang ldan na sngar ltar bdun dang bcas brgyad dang ldan pas khyab pa'i phyir/ kun shes dang de ldan pa'i dbang po chos can/ khyod dang ldan na bcu gcig dang ldan te/ bde ba yid bde btang snyoms srog yid dang dad sogs lnga kun shes pa'i dbang po'am de ldan pa'i dbang po dang bcu gcig ldan pa'i phyir/ kun shes byed pa'i dbang po chos can/ khyod dang ldan na bcu gsum dag dang ldan pas khyab ste/

yid srog lus gsum dang tshor ba'i dbang po gnyis/ dad sogs lnga dang*/ yid bde btang snyoms gnyis/ khyod rang bcas bcu gsum ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa srid ldan la/ nyung ldan dang*/ mang ldan gnyis/ dang po ni/ dge med nang na nyung ldan pa/ /lus tshor srog yid brgyad dang ldan/ /gzugs med byis pa'ang de bzhin te/ /btang snyoms srog yid dge rnams dang*/ /zhes byung*/ dge rtsa chad nas med pa'i gang zag gi nang nas dbang po nyung ngu dang ldan na brgyad dang ldan te/ lus tshor ba lnga dang srog yid brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gzugs med kyi byis pa'ang chos can/ dbang po brgyad dang ldan te/ snga ma de bzhin du btang snyoms srog yid dang dad sogs dge ba lnga ste brgyad rnams dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mang por ldan la bcu dgu ste/ dri ma med rnams ma gtogs so/ /zhes byung*/ mtshan gnyis dang ldan pa'i 'dod pa'i so skye chos can/ dbang po mang po dang ldan te/ dri med kyi dbang po rnams ma gtogs bcu dgu dang ldan pa'i phyir/ rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong lta bu'i 'phags pa chags bcas chos can/ dbang po bcu dgu dang ldan te/ sngar gyi steng nas pho mo'i mtshan ma gang rung gcig ma gtogs bco brgyad dang*/ dri med phyi ma gnyis ma gtogs pa lhag ma rnams dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ 7 /gnyis pa 'dus byas skye tshul la/ /gzugs tshan skye tshul dang*/ de min pa'i skye tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod na dbang po med pa dang*/ /sgra med phra rab rdul rdzas brgyad/ /lus dbang ldan la rdzas dgu'o/ /dbang po gzhan ldan rdzas bcu'o/ /zhes byung*/ 'di la gnyis/ tshig don dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'dod pa na dbang pos zin pa med pa'i rdul phra rab gcig skye ba'i tshe rdul rdzas brgyad cig char du skye ste/ de skye ba'i tshe 'byung bzhi'i rdul dang sgra med pa ste ma gtogs pa'i gzugs dri ro reg bya'i rdul phra rab bcas brgyad cig car du skye ba'i phyir/

'dod par lus dbang dang ldan pa la rdzas dgu cig car skye ste/ snga ma brgyad lus dbang dang dgu skye ba'i phyir/ dbang po gzhan mig rna ba sna lce dang ldan pa la rdzas bcu dus cig car skye ste/ snga ma dgu dang mgo sogs gang rung bcas bcu skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig /rdzas rdul phra rab med par thal/ bsags rdul phra rab las chung ba'i rdul med pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags der thal/ /rang 'grel las/ de yang chung ba ni mi mngon no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de yod par thal/ gangs spel las/ rdul phra rab ni rnam pa gnyis te/ rdzas kyi rdul phra rab dang bsags pa'i rdul phra rab bo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /slob dpon gyis rdzas rdul phra rab bzhed par thal/ bye smra'i lugs 'dir de yod par 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na/ mi 'thad bar thal/ slob dpon dang mdo sde pas de khas mi len par bshad pa'i phyir/ kha cig /'dod pa'i rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus kyi gong bu phra rab gcig la/ rdul phra rab brgyad yod par thal/ de rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus kyi gong bu yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de lta bu'i gong bu phra rab gcig yod pa'i phyir na snga mar ma khyab/ 'dod na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ rdul rdzas brgyad 'dren pa'i tshe sa chu me rlung bzhi dang*/ gzugs dri ro reg bya bzhi ste brgyad kyi rdzas 'dren pa gang zhig /de ltar rdul brgyad 'dus par rdul phra rab gcig tu khas len dgos pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ de mi 'thad par thal/ rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus ces pa ni rdzas sam nus pa 'dus pa yin gyi/ rdzas ril ril brgyad tshang ba'i don ma yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /rdo sra ba lta bu zhig la sa khams yod kyang gzhan gsum med par thal/ de la rlung rdzas med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de la g.yo ba med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de g.yo ba'i khams ma yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na/ gzhan gsum yod par thal/

de las sdud pa dang me khams dro ba dang chu rdzas gsher ba dang rlung khams g.yo ba rnams yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de la sa khams shas che yang gzhan gsum nus pa'i tshul gyis yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig /bsags rdul phra rab gcig la rdul rdzas brgyad ngo bo tha dad du dmigs par thal/ de la rdul rdzas brgyad tshang ba'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na/ mi 'thad par thal/ de la de brgyad kyi ngo bo so sor bzung bar mi nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ mtshungs ldan 'du byed dang*/ ldan min 'du byed gnyis/ dang po la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sems dang sems byung nges lhan cig/thams cad 'dus byas mtshan nyid dang*/ thob pa'am zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ gtso sems gcig skye ba'i tshe 'khor sems byung dang lhan cig nges par skye bas khyab ste/ sems sems byung gnyis phan tshun gcig med par cig shos ma skyes pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang 'grel las/ 'di dag ni phan tshun med na 'byung bar mi nus so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas thams cad chos can/ skye ba'i tshe rang gi mtshan nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum mi rtag pa dang bzhi lhan cig skye bar khyab ste/ de rnams dang 'bral med du ldan pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gang zag gi rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i 'dus byas chos can/ khyod yin na snga ma'i steng du rang gi thob pa dang lhan cig skye bas kyang khyab ste/ khyod yin na gang zag de nyid kyi rgyud la ldan par byed pa'i rdzas zhig yod pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'am zhes smos pa la dgos pa yod de/ rgyud du gtogs mi gtogs la thob pa yod med kyi khyad par bstan pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sems byung spyi'i rnam gzhag/gtso sems gang gi 'khor du sems byung du 'gro ba/ zhar la sems byung 'ga' zhig gi khyad par bshad pa gsum/ dang po la/ nges pa'i mtshungs ldan 'du byed dang*/ ma nges pa'i mtshungs ldan 'du byed gnyis/

dang po la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sems byung rnam lnga ste/ sa mang la sogs tha dad phyir/ zhes byung*/ nges pa'i mtshungs ldan gyi sems byung chos can/ khyod la skye tshul rnam pa lnga yod de/ sems kyi sa mang po la sogs te dge ba'i sa ba/ nyon mongs chen po'i sa ba/ mi dge ba'i sa ba/ nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa ba ste tha dad pa lnga yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la lnga'i dang po ni/ tshor dang sems pa 'du shes dang*/ /'dun dang reg dang blo gros dran/ /yid la byed dang mos pa dang*/ /ting nge 'dzin sems thams cad la/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ 'di pa'i lugs kyi sa mang po pa bcu yod de/ yul myong ba'i tshor ba dang*/ 'du byed pa'i sems pa dang*/ yul dang 'dus nas shes pa'i 'du shes dang*/ don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa dang*/ yul dbang rnam shes gsum dang phrad nas skyes pa'i reg pa dang*/ chos rnam par 'byed pa'i blo gros shes rab dang*/ mi brjed pa'i dran pa dang*/ sems kyi 'jug pa yid la byed pa dang*/ yul de 'dod pa'i mos pa dang*/ rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang bcu yod pa'i phyir/ de bcu chos can/ sa mang zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sems kyi skad cig thams cad dang sa thams cad la 'byung ba'i phyir/ lnga'i gnyis pa ni/ dad dang bag yod shin tu sbyangs/ btang snyoms ngo tsha shes khrel yod/ /rtsa ba gnyis rnam mi 'tshe dang*/ /brtson 'grus rtag tu dge la 'byung*/ /zhes byung*/ sems dngas ba'i dad pa dang*/ yon tan la gces spras byed pa'i bag yod dang*/ sems las rung gi shin tu sbyangs pa dang*/ sems mnyam pa nyid kyi 'du byed btang snyoms dang*/ ngo tsha shes pa dang*/ khrel yod pa dang*/ chags med dang zhe sdang med pa'i rtsa ba gnyis dang*/ gzhan la mi 'tshe ba dang*/ dge ba'i brtson 'grus dang bcu chos can/ dge ba'i sa mang zhes bya ste/ dge ba'i sems kun gyi 'khor du 'gro ba'i phyir/

gsum pa ni/ rmongs dang bag med le lo dang*/ /ma dad pa dang rmugs dang rgod/ /nyon mongs can la rtag tu 'byung*/ /zhes byung*/ rmongs pa ste ma rig pa dang*/ bag med dang*/ le lo dang*/ ma dad pa dang*/ rmugs sems dang*/ ma zhi ba'i rgod pa dang drug chos can/ nyon mongs chen po'i sa pa yin te/ rtag tu nyon mongs can gyi sems thams cad kyi 'khor du 'byung ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ mi dge la ni khrel med dang*/ /ngo tsha med pa'o zhes byung*/ khrel med dang ngo tsha med pa gnyis chos can/ mi dge ba'i sa mang yin te/ mi dge ba'i sa mang po thams cad kyi 'khor kho nar 'byung ba'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ khro ba dang*/ khon du 'dzin dang g.yo dang ni/ phrag dog 'tsheg 'chab ser sna dang*/ /sgyu dang rgyags dang rnam 'tshe ni/ /nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa ba rnams/ /zhes byung*/ mnar sems kyis khro ba dang*/ sha gnyer ba'i 'khon du 'dzin pa dang*/ sems sgyur ba'i g.yo dang*/ gzhan gyi phun tshogs la phrag dog dang*/ sdig la zhen pa'i 'tshig pa dang*/ nyes pa sbed pa'i 'chab sems dang*/ ser sna dang*/ yon tan de med kyang yod par ston pa'i sgyu dang*/ rang gi chos la chags pa'i rgyags pa dang*/ gzhan la 'tho 'tsham pa'i rnam 'tshe dang bcu po rnams chos can/ nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa pa yin te/ grogags chung ngu spang bya'i sgo nas chung ngu sa rnams kyi chung ngur bzhag pa'i phyir/ der thal/ grogs ma rig pa dang mtshungs ldan/ sgom spang kho na/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa'i yid kyi rnam shes kho na dang mtshungs ldan yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma nges pa'i mtshungs ldan ni/ 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ the tshom bzhi dang*/ gzhan 'gyur bzhi dang brgyad po chos can/ ma nges pa zhes bya ste/ sa de gang du'ang ma nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ 'dod pa dang*/ khams gong ma'i dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dge ba dang*/ mi dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan gyi dbang du byas pa gsum/ dang po ni/

'dod pa'i dge ba'i sems la ni/ /rtog dang dpyod dang bcas pa'i phyir/ /sems las byung ba nyi shu gnyis/ /la la dag tu 'gyod pa bsnan/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ 'dod pa'i dge sems kyi 'khor du sems las byung ba nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod de/ sems kyi sa mang bcu/ dge ba'i sa mang bcu/ rtog dpyod gnyis dang bcas pa'i nyer gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ nyer gsum 'byung ba'ang yod de/ la la dag tu sdig pa la 'gyod pa bsnan pas de ltar du 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la ma 'dres pa dang*/ 'dres pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ mi dge la ni ma 'dres dang*/ /lta dang ldan la'ang nyi shu 'byung*/ /zhes byung*/ chags sogs gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i lta ba phyi ma gsum dang mtshung ldan gyi 'dod pa'i mi dge ba'i sems chos can/ khyod kyi 'khor du sems byung nyi shu 'byung ba yod de/ sems kyi sa mang bcu/ nyon mongs chen po'i sa mang drug/dge ba'i sa mang gnyis/ rtog dpyod gnyis rnams 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ nyon mongs bzhi dang khro sogs dang*/ /'gyod pa dang ni nyi shu gcig/zhes byung*/ 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal the tshom nyon mongs can bzhi mtshungs ldan nges pa'i sems chos can/ khyod kyi 'khor du nyer gcig 'byung ste/ snga ma nyi shu dang 'dod chags sogs bzhi po gang rung gcig dang nyi shu rtsa gcig 'byung ba'i phyir/ khro sogs nas rnam 'tshe'i bar gyi nye nyon bcu rnams dang mtshungs ldan gyi mi dge ba'i sems chos can/ khyod kyi 'khor la'ang nyi shu rtsa gcig 'byung ste/ snga ma nyi shu dang nye nyon de dang de gang rung bsnan pas nyer gcig 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'gyod pa la'ang de dang 'dra ba 'byung ste/ snga ma nyi shu dang de la dge mi dge gnyis yod pa'i gang rung 'byung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ bsgribs la bco brgyad lung ma bstan/ /gzhan la bcu gnyis dag tu 'dod/ /gnyid ni kun dang mi 'gal phyir/

/gang la yod pa de bsnan no/ /zhes byung*/ bsgribs lung ma bstan gyi gtso sems chos can/ khyod kyi 'khor du bco brgyad 'byung ba yod de/ sems kyi sa mang bcu/ nyon mongs chen po'i sa mang drug/rtog dpyod gnyis dang bcas pa 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan ma bsgribs lung ma bstan gyi sems chos can/ khyod la bcu gnyis 'byung ba yod de/ sems kyi sa mang bcu dang*/ rtog dpyod gnyis rnams 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ gnyid ni chos can/ khyod dge mi dge bsgribs ma bsgribs lung ma bstan gang la yod pa de la bsnan rigs te/ de kun dang mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ der thal/ khyod du gyur pa'i de rnams yod pa'i phyir/ de dag las zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de dang de skye ba'i go skabs kyi yul yin pas na sa'am sa pa zhes brjod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa khams gong ma'i dbang du byas pa ni/ de la 'gyod gnyid mi dge rnams/ /bsam gtan dang po dag na med/ /rtog pa'ang bsam gtan khyad par can/ /de yi gong na dpyod pa yang*/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ sems byung de las 'gyod pa dang gnyid dang mi dge ba rnams ni bsam gtan dang po dag na med de/ /de dag la chags pa dang bral ba'i phyir dang*/ der ma zad/ rtog dpyod kyi rtog pa'ang bsam gtan khyad par can na med la/ de'i gong bsam gtan gnyis pa yan chad na dpyod pa yang med pa'i phyir/ yang sgra'i don yod de/ der mi dge ba'i rtog dpyod sogs med par ma zad/ g.yo sgyu yang med ces pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sems byung 'ga' zhig gi khyad par la/ sems byung brgyad kyi khyad par dang*/ sems sems byung gi ming gi rnam grangs gnyis/ dang po ni/ ma gus ngo tsha med khrel med/ kha na ma tho 'jigs me lta/ /dga' dang gus nyid ngo tsha shes/ /de gnyis 'dod dang gzugs dag na/ /rtog dang dpyod pa rtsing zhib nyid/ /nga rgyal khengs pa rgyags pa ni/ /rang gi chos la chags pa yi/

/sems ni yongs su gtogs pa'o/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ sems byung gi ngo tsha med pa dang khrel med kyi khyad par yod de/ bye smra ltar na yon tan dang yon tan can la ma gus pa ngo tsha med pa dang*/ kha na ma tho ba la 'jigs par mi lta ba ni khrel med pa yin la/ slob dpon ltar na rang dang gzhan la ltos nas nyes pa la mi 'dzem pa gnyis rim pa bzhin ngo tsha med pa dang khrel med du 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa der thal/ der gnyis las ldog pa ni ngo tsha yod pa dang khrel yod yin pa'i phyir/ dga' ba dang gus pa nyid kyi khyad par yod de/ yul la dga' ba la nyon mongs can yin min gnyis yod de/ yul khyad par can la dad cing gus pa ni ngo tsha shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ zur dang po der thal/ dga' ba la bu dang chung ma sogs la dga' ba dang*/ yon tan can la dga' ba gnyis yod cing*/ spyir dga' dad la mu bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dga' ba dang gus pa de gnyis ni 'dod pa dang gzugs khams dag na yod kyang gzugs med na med de/ gzugs med na gang zag phan tshun mngon sum gyi yul ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtog pa dang dpyod pa gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ rtog pa ni rtsing ba dang dpyod pa ni zhib pa nyid kyi rnam pas 'jug pa'i phyir/ nga rgyal chos can/ yod de/ sems khengs pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/ /rgyags pa chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ rang gi chos la rang gis chags la chags pa yi sems yongs su gtugs pa'i sems byung zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/ nga rgyal dang khyad par yod de/ de ni sems khengs pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sems dang yid dang rnam shes ni/ /don gcig sems dang sems byung dang*/ /rten dang dmigs dang rnam bcas dang*/ /mtshungs par ldan pa rnam pa lnga/ /zhes byung*/ gsung rab nas bshad pa'i sems dang yid dang rnam shes rnams chos can/ don tha dad pa ma yin te/

don gcig yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rnam par rig pa'i gtso sems su mtshungs pa'i phyir/ ming gis tha dad du bshad pa'i sgra don yod de/ don rnam par 'byed pas na sems dang*/ don shes pas yid dang*/ yul gzugs sogs la dmigs nas rnam par shes par byed pas na rnam shes su bshad pa'i phyir/ mdo sems gnyis na re/ rnam grangs kyi tha dad de/ bag chags bsags pas na sems dang*/ rten du gyur pas na yid dang*/ da lta'i dngos po la bltos pas na rnam shes su bshad pa'i phyir gsung*/ sems dang sems byung rnams chos can/ khyod rten bcas dang dmigs bcas dang rnam bcas dang mtshungs ldan zhes brjod cing*/ don gcig la 'jug ste/ khyod dbang po la brten/ yul la dmigs rnam pa khyad par du gcod/ mtshungs par ldan pa rnam pa lnga dang bcas pa'i phyir/ phyi ma der thal/ rten dang dmigs pa dang rnam pa dang dus dang rdzas lnga mtshungs pa'i phyir/ de lngas mtshungs te/ gtso sems rten gang la brten pa de la 'khor sems byung rnams kyang brten/ dmigs pa gang las sems skye ba de las 'khor sems byung rnams skye/ sems yul gang gi rnam par skyes pa ltar 'khor sems byung rnams kyang skyes/ sems dus gang gi tshe skyes pa na 'khor sems byung rnams kyang skyes/ sems rdzas rigs gcig pa ltar de dang 'khor sems byung rnams kyang rdzas rigs gcig pa'i phyir/ gong du bshad pa'i sems sems byung la spyi don gyis mdor bsdus bshad na/ gtso sems kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rang gi 'khor sems byung dang mtshungs ldan lngas mtshungs pa'i rnam rig de de yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na drug yod de/ rnam shes tshogs drug yod pa'i phyir/ sems byung gi mtshan nyid yod de/ gtso sems gang gi 'khor du byung zhing de dang mtshungs ldan rnam pa lngas mtshungs pa'i rig pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ dbye ba yod de/ kun btus ltar na nga gcig dang*/ skabs 'di'i sde tshan lngas dbye na zhe drug yod pa'i phyir/

dang po grub ste/ kun 'gro lnga/ yul nges lnga/ dge ba bcu gcig /rtsa nyon drug /nye nyon nyi shu / gzhan 'gyur bzhi rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ sems kyi sa mang bcu/ dge ba'i sa mang bcu/ nyon mongs chen po'i sa mang drug mi dge ba'i sa pa gnyis/ nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa pa bcu/ 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal the tshom bzhi/ gzhan 'gyur bzhi dang brgyad rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gtso 'khor gyi don yod de/ sems la rten dmigs pa sogs lnga rang dbang yod/ sems byung rnams sems kyi de la ma brten par de lnga rang dbang du med pa'i phyir/ kha cigabartson 'grus la dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum yod par thal/ gnyid dang 'gyod pa la de gsum yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ mi dge ba'i phyogs dang bya ba gzhan ngan pa la 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus te brtson 'grus ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de le lo ngan la zhen pa dang*/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cigadage ba'i rtsa ba gsum med par thal/ 'dir rtsa ba gnyis zhes 'byung ba'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ 'dir chags med dang sdang med kyis gti mug med pa yang sdud pa'i phyir/ kha cig /bsam gtan dang po sogs na mi dge ba yod par thal/ de dag na rang sar chags pa'i sred pa yod pa'i phyir na skyon med de/ de yod kyang lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gong ma thams cad lung ma bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /sems sems byung rnams rnam pa mi mtshungs par thal/ sems byung sna tshogs pa rnams kyis yul sna tshogs la dmigs pa'i tshe rnam pa yang sna tshogs 'byung la/ sems kyi rnam pa sems byung ltar sna tshogs su mi 'gyur ba'i phyir zer ba dang*/ mig gi rnam shes kyis gzugs sna tshogs la bltas pa'i tshe de'i 'khor du gyur pa'i tshor 'du sogs lnga po re rer gzugs sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa shar bar thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ tshor ba ma myong ba dang*/

'du shes kyis dran pa sogs don 'dra bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab po/ /gnyis pa ldan min 'du byed la/ dbye ba mdor bstan pa dang*/ rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ khyad par gzhan bstan pa'i sgo nas don bsdu ba gsum/ dang po ni/ mi ldan pa yi 'du byed rnams/ thob dang ma thob skal mnyam dang*/ /'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug dang*/ /srog dang mtshan nyid rnams dang ni/ /ming gi tshogs la sogs pa yang*/ /zhes byung*/ mi ldan pa ste ldan min 'du byed rnams chos can/ khyod la dbye na bcu bzhi yod de/ thob pa dang ma thob pa dang skal mnyam dang 'du shes med pa dang de'i snyoms 'jug dang srog dang*/ 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid skye rga gnas pa mi rtag pa bzhi rnams dang*/ ming gi tshogs dang*/ la sogs pa ngag gi tshogs dang*/ yi ge'i tshogs dang bcu bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ thob pa sogs gsum bshad pa dang*/ 'du shes med pa sogs gsum bshad pa dang*/ srog sogs lnga bshad pa dang*/ ming tshig sogs gsum bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ thob ma thob dang*/ skal mnyam bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ thob ma thob kyi ngo bo dang*/ khyad chos gnyis/ dang po ni/ thob pa rnyed dang ldan pa'o/ /thob dang ma thob rang rgyud du/ /gtogs pa rnams kyi'o 'gog gnyis kyi/ /zhes byung*/ thob pa chos can/ khyod kyi 'jog tshul yod de/ rang gang la ldan pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la ldan par byed pa'i rdzas zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod la dbye na gnyis yod de/ rnyed thob dang ldan thob gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ sngar ma thob pa dang thob kyang nyams pa slar gsar du rnyed byed kyi rdzas zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ snga ma ni mthong lam gsar du thob pa lta bu dang*/ gnyis pa ni bsam gzugs las nyams pa slar gsar du thob pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ldan thob yod de/ thob zin skad cig gnyis pa phan chad du ldan par byed pa'i rdzas zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/

ma thob pa chos can/ khyod 'jog tshul yod de/ thob bya de gang zag de'i rgyud la ldan pa la gegs byed pa'i rdzas zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod la gnyis yod de/ rnyed pa'i ma thob pa dang*/ ldan pa'i ma thob pa gnyis gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ dang po ni/ thob bya'i chos de gsar du rnyed pa la gegs byed kyi rdzas zhig dang*/ phyi ma ni chos de gang zag de'i rgyud la rgyun du ldan pa la gegs byed pa'i rdzas zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/ thob dang ma thob gnyis chos can/ gang zag de rnams kyi rang rgyud du gtogs pa zhig dgos te/ gzhan rgyud du gtogs pa sogs kyis mi chog pa'i phyir/ thob ma thob gnyis 'dus byas kho na'i steng du brtsi bar ma nges te/ 'gog pa gnyis kyi thob ma thob kyang yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir kha cig /thob pa dang rnyed pa dang ldan pa gsum don gcig zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ thob pa dbye gzhi dang*/ gzhan gnyis dbye ba'i ya gyal yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang 'grel las/ thob pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /rnyed thob dang ldan thob gnyis 'gal gsung pa ni mi 'thad de/ de gnyis su phye ba'i rnyed thob dang ldan thob 'gal yang*/ spyir de gnyis mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ der thal/ sdug bsngal chos bzod skad cig dang po de rnyed pa thob pa ldan pa gsum ka yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gangs spel las/ thob pa dang rnyed pa dang ldan pa'i sgra don gcig par 'dod mod kyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa khyad chos so sor bshad pa la/ thob pa'i khyad chos dang*/ ma thob pa'i khyad chos gnyis/ dang po la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ dmigs bsal gnyis/ dang po ni/ dus gsum pa yi rnam pa gsum/ dge la sogs kyi dge la sogs/ / der gtogs rnams kyi rang khams pa/ /ma gtogs rnams kyi rnam pa bzhi/ / slob dang mi slob min gyi gsum/ /spang bya min pa'i rnam gnyis 'dod/

/ces byung*/ 'di la gnyis/ tshig don dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thob pa chos can/ khyod la dus gsum bzhag tu yod de/ ltos sa la ltos nas dus gsum dang*/ dus re re la yang 'das pa'i thob pa ma 'ongs pa'i thob pa da lta ba'i thob pa rnam pa gsum gsum yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos 'das pa'i thob pa la yang 'das ma 'ongs da lta ba gsum yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ so thar lta bu'i thob pa skyes la 'gags pa ni 'das pa yin la/ de'i sngar thob pa skyes pa 'das pa'i 'das pa dang de'i phyis skye ba'i thob pa 'das pa'i ma 'ongs pa dang de dang lhan cig thob pa ni 'das pa'i da lta ba yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du nyon mongs sam dge ba gang yin yang thob pa skyes la ma 'gag de da lta ba dang*/ de'i sngar skyes pa de'i 'das pa dang*/ de'i phyis skye ba de'i ma 'ongs pa dang*/ de dang lhan cig skyes pa de'i da lta ba yin te/ gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre ba'i phyir/ thob pa chos can/ khyod la dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum yod de/ dge ba'i thob pa dge ba dang*/ la sogs pas mi dge ba'i thob pa mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi thob pa ni lung ma bstan du 'jog pa gtso che ba'i phyir/ der thal/ dge la sogs pa zhes pas go rim de ltar sbyong bar bstan pa'i phyir/ thob pa chos can/ khyod la khams gsum gyi sar gtogs pa yod de/ thob bya'i chos khams gsum po gang yin pa der gtogs pa rnams kyi thob pa ni rang gi khams der gtogs pa ste sa des bsdus pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ thob bya'i chos khams gsum gyi sar ma gtogs pa rnams kyi khyad par rnam pa bzhi yod de/ thob bya'i chos khams gsum gyi sar ma gtogs la/ thob pa de gsum gyis bsdus pa sogs mu gsum/ chos de khams gsum gang rung gi sar ma gtogs la/ thob pa de gsum gang rung gis ma bsdus pa'i mu dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ rtags der thal/ khams gsum pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa 'dod pa'i sar ma gtogs kyang*/

de'i thob pa ni gang zag gang du gtogs pa der gtogs pa gsum/ so sor brtags 'gog gi thob pa zag bcas gong ma gnyis su gtogs la/ so sor brtags 'gog dang lam bden khams gsum gang du ma gtogs shing de'i thob pa zag med rnams khams gsum gang du yang mi gtogs pa'i phyir/ slob pa dang mi slob pa'i chos zag med kyi thob pa chos can/ rim pa bzhin du rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag slob pa dang mi slob par mtshon par byed pa'i chos yin te/ slob mi slob pa'i lam bden gyis bsdus pa'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ slob mi slob gang rung min pa'i chos chos can/ khyod la gsum yod de/ khyod la slob mi slob gang rung ma yin pa dang*/ slob pa dang mi slob par byed pa'i chos gsum yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ zag bcas dang 'dus ma byas rnams ni slob mi slob gang rung min pa'i chos/ so sor brtags 'gog slob pa'i lam gyis thob pa'i thob pa ni slob pa dang de mi slob pa'i lam gyis thob pa'i thob pa ni mi slob par byed pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ thob bya'i chos spang bya ma yin pa chos can/ khyod kyi thob pa la rnam pa gnyis 'dod de/ spang bya dang spang bya ma yin pa rnam pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig /thob bya'i chos khams gsum gang du gtogs pa rnams kyi thob pa yang 'dod par gtogs so zer na/ de mi 'thad de/ gong du bshad cing 'chad pa'i phyir/ kha cig /ma gtogs rnams kyi rnam pa bzhi zhes pa'i skabs kyi ma gtogs pa'i don lam bden de khams gsum du mi gtogs pa'i don yin zer na/ de yang mi 'thad par thal/ de zag med kyi thob pa bzhi la byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang 'grel las/ zag pa med pa'i chos rnams kyi thob pa ni mdor bsdu na rnam pa bzhi ste/ khams gsum pa dang zag pa med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /slob pa'i thob pa slob pa/ mi slob pa'i thob pa mi slob pa yin no zer na/

de yang mi 'thad par thal/ slob pa dang mi slob pa gnyis ka gang zag gi steng nas 'jog rigs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ slob mi slob tu byed pa'i chos slob pa dang mi slob pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bdag sgra sbyar ma sbyar la khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba'ang yod do/ /gnyis pa dmigs bsal ni/ lung bstan min thob lhan cig skye/ / mngon shes sprul pa ma gtogs pa/ /bsgribs pa'i gzugs kyi'ang 'dod pa na/ /gzugs kyi sngar ni skye ba med/ /ces byung*/ ma sgrib lung ma bstan min pa chos can/ khyod kyi thob pa bzhag tu yod de/ rang dang lhan cig skye ba'i thob pa yod pa'i phyir/ thob pa de chos can/ khyod la dus gsum tsam yod kyang de re re la ni dus gsum so sor med de/ khyod kyi dus gsum gyi thob pa rnams dus gsum re re ba kho na yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de dag gi thob pa spyir sngar skyes dang phyis skyes med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang rang dang lhan cig kho nar skye ba'i phyir/ dmigs bsal ma nges pa'ang yod de/ lung ma bstan gyi thob pa la sngar skyes phyis skyes lhan cig skyes gsum dang*/ snga ma med la phyi ma gnyis yod pa srid pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ mig gi mngon shes lung ma bstan dang*/ sprul sems lung ma bstan dang bi shwa karma'i bzo ba'i gnas lta bu dang ston pa'i spyod lam lta bu yod pa'i phyir gnyis pa grub ste/ mngon shes dang sprul pa lta bu ma gtogs par dge ba dang bsgribs pa'i gzugs kyi thob pa 'dod pa na yod pa la gzugs kyi sngar skyes med cing phyis skyes dang da ltar skyes yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma thob pa'i khyad chos la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ gtong tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ ma thob ma bsgribs lung ma bstan/ /'das ma skyes kyi de rnam gsum/ 'dod sogs gtogs dang dri med kyi'ang*/ lam ma thob pa so so yi/ /skye bor 'dod de zhes byung*/

dge mi dge lung ma bstan gang rung gi ma thob pa chos can/ lung ma bstan yin te/ ma bsgribs lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ dge mi dge gang rung ma yin te/ dge rtsa chad pa dang mi dge spangs pa la'ang khyod yod pa'i phyir/ bsgribs lung ma bstan ma yin te/ dgra bcom pa'i rgyud la'ang yod pa'i phyir/ ma thob pa chos can/ dus gsum gang 'jog gi khyad par yod de/ thob bya'i chos 'das pa'i 'das pa sogs gsum dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'das pa sogs gsum dang*/ da lta ba'i 'das ma 'ongs gnyis tsam yod pa'i phyir/ 'das pa dang ma skyes pa ste ma 'ongs pa gnyis kyi dus de rnam gsum yod kyi/ 'dir thob bya'i da lta ba'i da ltar ba med de/ da ltar ba'i thob bya ma thob pa da ltar bar 'jog par 'gal ba'i phyir/ ma thob pa 'dod khams sogs su gtogs pa gsum yod de/ rten gyi gang zag gang du skyes pa'i sa der gtogs pa gsum yod pa'i phyir/ dri med lam bden gyi thob pa'ang chos can/ khams gsum gang rung du gtogs te/ rten gyi gang zag skyes pa'i sar gtogs pa'i phyir/ lam bden gyi ma thob pa chos can/ dri med ma yin te/ so so'i skye bo'i rgyud kyi zag bcas yin par 'dod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gtong tshul ni/ de thob dang*/ sa 'phos nas ni nyams par 'gyur/ zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ ma thob pa'i gtong rgyu yod de/ rtogs pa'i yon tan ma thob pa de thob pas gtong*/ sa dgu'i ma thob pa ni sa de dang der 'phos pa'i rgyus gtong ba'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ tshogs lam pas sbyor lam thob pa'i tshe sbyor lam ma thob pa nyams shing*/ so skyes 'phags lam thob pa'i rgyus de ma thob pa nyams par 'gyur ba sogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ 'dod khams pa bsam gtan dang por skyes pa'i tshe sa 'phos nas bsam gtan gyi ma thob pa gtong zhing nyams pa sogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa skal mnyam ni/ skal mnyam sems can 'dra ba'o/

/zhes byung*/ skal mnyam gyi rdzas chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ /sems can rnams kyi ris 'dra ba'am mthun pa zhes bya ba'i rdzas zhig yin pa'i phyir/ skal mnyam chos can/ gnyis yod de/ tha dad min pa dang tha dad pa'i skal mnyam gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ snga ma ni sems can tsam du 'dra ba'i rdzas dang*/ phyi ma ni lha mi sogs so sor 'dra bar byed pa'i rdzas zhig yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'du shes med pa sogs gsum la/ 'du shes med pa dang*/ de'i snyoms 'jug dang*/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gsum/ dang po ni/ 'du shes med pa ba 'du shes/ /med par sems dang sems byung rnams/ /'gog pa'i rnam smin de 'bras che/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ 'du shes med pa ba'i gang zag gi 'du shes med par 'jog pa'i rdzas yod de/ gnas der skyes pa'i gang zag gi sems dang sems byung rnams 'gog pa'i 'du shes gang yin pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ de 'dra ba'i rdzas de chos can/ rnam smin yin te/ 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug gam rnam smin yin pa'i phyir/ 'du shes med pa'i lha rnams chos can/ bsam gtan bzhi pa ba yin te/ de 'bras bu che ba'i lhar gtogs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin 'du shes med snyoms 'jug / bsam gtan tha mar 'byung 'dod pas/ /dge ba'o skyes nas myong 'gyur nyid/ / 'phags pa'i ma yin dus gcig 'thob/ /zhes byung*/ 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug chos can/ khyod kyi ngo bo yod de/ snga ma de bzhin du sems dang sems byung 'gog par byed pa'i snyoms 'jug zhig de yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ bsam gtan bzhi par gtogs pa yin te/ bsam gtan tha ma ste bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la brten nas 'byung bar 'dod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ dge ba yin te/ snyoms 'jug yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ skyes nas myong bar 'gyur ba nyid yin te/ gsum gyi nang nas mthong chos la myong 'gyur sogs gzhan gnyis gang rung ma yin pa'i dge ba'i snyoms 'jug yin pa'i phyir/

de chos can/ skye ba'i rten so skyer nges te/ 'phags pa min pa kho na'i snyoms 'jug yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ dang por gcig kho nar thob pa yin te/ da ltar gyi dus gcig kho nar thob kyi/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi thob pa med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'gog pa zhes pa'ang de bzhin nyid/ /'di gnas don du srid rtse skyes/ /dge ba'o gnyis su myong 'gyur dang*/ /ma nges 'phags pa'i sbyor las 'thob/ /thub pa'i byang chub kyis thob bya/ /dang po ma yin skad cig ma/ /sum cu rtsa bzhis thob phyir ro/ /gnyis ka'ang 'dod dang gzugs rten can/ /'gog pa dang por mi'i nang du/ /zhes byung*/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug zhes pa'ang chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ sems sems byung 'gog pa'i tshul sngar bshad pa de bzhin du mtshungs pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de la snyoms par 'jug pa'i kun slong dang dgos pa yod de/ zhi ba'i yid byed 'di la gnas na zhi ba'o snyam nas de'i don du snyoms par 'jug pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ sems rten dang sa gang du gtogs pa yod de/ srid rtser gtogs shing der skye ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ dge mi dge gang rung yin te/ dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ myong 'gyur gyi khyad par yod de/ skyes nas myong 'gyur dang lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur ba'i gnyis su myong 'gyur dang*/ rnam smin mi myong ba'i ma nges pa gcig ste gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi rten yod de/ 'phags pa kho na'i sbyor ba las 'thob pa'i phyir/ thub pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ni sbyor ba dang 'bad pas thob pa min te/ des zad mi skye shes pa'i byang chub thob pa'i tshe de 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bskyed tshul la/ kha cig/dang por byang sems slob pa'i dus su thob zer ba sogs gnyis las/ dang po ma yin te/ bden pa skad cig ma mngon rtogs bcu drug dang*/ srid rtse'i bar gyi sgom spang skor dgu'i gnyen po bar chad med lam dgu dang*/

de'i rnam grol lam dgu ste sum cu rtsa bzhi bar ma chad par byang chub thob pa'i phyir/ 'du shes med pa dang 'gog pa gnyis ka'ang chos can/ 'dod pa dang gzugs khams gnyis ka'i rten can la thob pa yod de/ dang po 'dod pa'i rten la thob pa nyams nas slar gzugs kyi rten la bskyed pa yod pa'i phyir/ khyad par cung zad yod de/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ni dang por mi'i nang du skye la/ phyis gzugs kyi rten la bskyed pa yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig/'gog pa dang po mi nang du zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ de gnyis ka'i rten la 'gog snyoms gsar du skye ba yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags der thal/ gzugs kyi rten la ma nyams pa'i gsar skye med kyang*/ nyams pa'i gsar skye yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rtsa bar/ gnyis ka 'dod dang gzugs rten can/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig/'gog snyoms thob pa'i gang zag yin na/ de mngon du byas pas khyab zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ de thob pa'i dgra bcom pa rjes thob pa rnams kyis de mngon du ma byas pa'i phyir/ gsum pa srog sogs lnga bshad pa la/ srog dbang bshad pa dang*/ 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ srog ni tshe yin drod dang ni/ /rnam shes rten gang yin pa'o/ /zhes byung*/ srog dbang chos can/ khyod kyi ngo bo yod de/ phung po'i rigs 'dra gnas pa'i tshe la 'dod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi byed las yod de/ 'dod gzugs gnyis na drod dang rnam shes kyi rten byed/ gzugs med du rnam shes kyi rten byed pa'i nus pa gang yin pa de yin pa'i phyir/ kha cigasrog dang tshe ni drod kyi rten du mi rigs par thal/ gzugs med na tshe srog yod kyang drod med pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ 'dir ni khams 'og ma'i dbang du mdzad pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ de mi 'thad par thal/ rnam shes dang tshe ni drod la ma ltos pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ drod chung ngur song na tsha srog chung ngur song bas khyab par thal/

ma grub pa de'i phyir na ma khyab/ kha cig/srog dang rlung gi gzhi mthun yod par thal/ rang 'grel las/ srog ces bya ba ni lus sems la brten nas 'jug pa de lta bu'i rlung yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ ming gis der btags pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mtshan nyid dag ni skye ba dang*/ /rga dang gnas dang mi rtag nyid/ /de dag skye ba'i skyes la sogs/ /de chos brgyad dang gcig la 'jug/rgyu dang rkyen dang med par ni/ /skye bas bskyed bya skyed byed min/ /zhes byung*/ 'dus byas chos can/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid dag yod de/ /skye ba dang rga ba dang gnas pa dang mi rtag pa nyid kyi chos de khyod kyi mtshon byed yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid de bzhi chos can/ khyod kyi ngo bo dang byed las yod de/ skye bas skyed par byed/ gnas pas gnas par byed/ rga bas rnying bar byed/ mi rtag pa nyid kyis chos de 'jig par byed pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas de dag gang rung zhig chos can/ mtshan nyid rjes mthun dang bcas na brgyad yod de/ rtsa ba'i mtshan nyid bzhi dang skye ba'i skye ba sogs te/ gnas pa'i gnas pa/ rga ba'i rga ba/ mi rtag pa'i mi rtag pa ste rjes mthun gyi mtshan nyid bzhi dang brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ skye sogs thug med du thal ba'i skyon med de/ chos de skye ba'i tshe rang gi skye sogs brgyad dang rang dang dgu cig car du lhan cig skye ba'i phyir/ der thal/ skye bas ni skye rga sogs brgyad skyed la/ gnas pas ni de brgyad gnas par byed pa sogs yin pas/ skye ba'i skye ba de skye ba gcig pu la 'jug pa dang gnas pa'i gnas pa sogs kyang chos re re'am gcig la 'jug pa'i phyir/ ma 'ongs pa kun cig car du skye bar thal/ skye bas skye ba'i brgyad skyed pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ rgyu dang rkyen dag tshogs pa med par ni skye ba kho nas bskyed bya skyed par byed pa ma yin pa'i phyir/

bzhi pa ni/ ming gi tshogs la sogs pa ni/ ming dang ngag dang yi ge'i tshogs/ 'dod dang gzugs gtogs sems can ston/ /rgyu mthun lung bstan min zhes byung*/ /ming gi tshogs la sogs pa las/ dang po ming chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i sgra yin pa'i sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir te/ dper na/ gzugs/ tshor ba zhes pa'i ngag lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ ngag chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ don gyi ngo bo khyad par dang bcas nas ston pa'i ngag yin pa'i sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir te/ dper na/ gzugs mdzes/ tshor ba myong zhes pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ yi ge chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ ming dang ngag gi rtsom gzhir gyur pa'i skad gyi gdangs zhig la byed pa'i phyir te/ dper na/ a i ka kha zhes pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ tshogs gsum po de chos can/ khams gang du gtogs pa yod de/ 'dod pa dang gzugs khams kho nar gtogs pa'i phyir/ de gsum po chos can/ khyad par gsum dang ldan te/ ngo bo sems can du ston pa'i sgra/ rgyu mthun las byung ba/ ma bsgribs lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ brjod mkhan gyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ rang gi rigs mthun snga ma las skyes pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ dge rtsa chad pa dang chags bral la'ang yod cing rnam smin mi skyed pa'i phyir/ kha cig/de mi 'thad de/ nam mkha' las kyang ming tshig yi ge gsum ldan gyi sgra 'byung ba'i phyir/ der thal/ nam mkha' las kyang chos kyi sgra/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu yod pa'i phyir zer na/ skyon med de/ de ni de ltar 'gyur bar byed pa po'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ de ltar ma yin na/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' brgyud kyis ma bsdus pa yod par thal bar 'gyur te/ dpyad dgos par yang snang ngo*/ /gsum pa chos gzhan gyi khyad par bstan pa'i sgo nas don bsdu ba ni/ de bzhin/ skal mnyam rnam par smin pa'ang yin/

khams gsum pa ste thob rnam gnyis/ /mtshan nyid rnams dang snyoms 'jug dang*/ mi ldan pa dag rgyu mthun pa/ zhes byung*/ skal mnyam chos can/ bshad ma thag pa de bzhin du chos gsum ldan du ma zad/ lnga ldan yang yin te/ ngo bo sems can du ston pa sogs gsum du ma zad/ skal mnyam dang rnam par smin pa'i rgyu las byung ba'am yin zhing*/ khams gsum pa ste de gsum gyi sar gtogs pa lnga yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi thob pa la rnam pa gnyis yod de/ rnam smin dang rgyu mthun las byung ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang gi rigs 'dra snga ma las byung ba ni rgyu mthun las byung ba dang*/ mig sogs rnam smin las byung ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid skye sogs rnams chos can/ khyod la byung ba gnyis yod de/ rgyu mthun dang rnam smin skyes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sems can du mi ston pa rgyu mthun dang*/ sems can du ston pa'i de bzhi rnam smin las byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ gong du bshad pa'i snyoms 'jug gnyis dang*/ mi ldan pa'i 'du byed de dag chos can/ rnam smin kyi rgyu las byung ba min te/ rgyu mthun kho na las byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa rgyu rkyen 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag la/ rgyu 'bras spyir bstan pa dang*/ rkyen bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyu dang 'bras bu bshad pa gnyis dang*/ de gnyis kyi thun mong gi chos bshad pa gsum/ dang po la/ dbye ba mdor bstan pa dang*/ rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba gsum/ dang po ni/ byed rgyu lhan cig 'byung ba dang*/ skal mnyam mtshungs par ldan pa dang*/ /kun tu 'gro dang rnam smin dang*/ /rgyu ni rnam pa drug tu 'dod/ / zhes byung*/ rgyu ni chos can/ rnam pa drug du 'dod de/ byed rgyu dang lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu dang skal mnyam gyi rgyu dang*/ mtshungs par ldan pa'i rgyu dang kun tu 'gro ba'i rgyu dang rnam smin gyi rgyu dang drug yod pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la drug las/ dang po byed rgyu ni/ rang las gzhan pa byed rgyu'i rgyu/ /zhes byung*/ byed rgyu chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ rang skye ba la gegs mi byed cing*/ rang las don gzhan pa'i chos zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/ byed rgyu chos can/ khyod la gnyis yod de/ skabs 'dir nus ldan dang nus med gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ chos de skye ba la phan 'dogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams ni/ chos de'i byed rgyu nus ldan dang*/ chos de skye ba la gegs mi byed kyang phan mi 'dogs pa'i chos de/ chos de'i byed rgyu nus med du 'jog pa'i phyir/ so so'i mtshan gzhi yod de/ chos de'i rgyu thams cad chos de'i byed rgyu nus ldan dang*/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams dang 'dus byas yin kyang de la mi gnod mi phan pa rnams/ chos de'i byed rgyu nus med du 'jog pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sa bon dang chu lud dang drod gsher sogs rang 'bras myu gu'i rgyu snga ma dang*/ ka bum la sogs pa ni de'i rgyu phyi ma yin pa'i phyir/ spyir byed rgyu thams cad nus ldan yin te/ 'dir byed rgyu nus stong ni gzhi la ltos nas yin pa'i phyir/ 'dus ma byas la dmigs nas yid shes skye zhing*/ de las dbang shes kyang skye ba yod de/ mdzod rang 'grel las/ rgyu brgyud pa'i sgo nas de yang rkyen du 'gyur ba'i phyir nus pa yod de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang bye smra'i lugs yin gy-i/ gong mas byed rgyu la 'dus byas kyis khyab par 'dod pas khyad par yod do/ /chos de skye ba la gnod pa ni chos de'i byed rgyu ma yin te/ de de'i 'jig byed yin pa'i phy-ir/ gnyis pa ni/ lhan cig 'byung gang phan tshun 'bras/ 'byung bzhin sems kyi rjes 'jug pa/ /sems dang mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi bzhin/ /sems las byung dang sdom gnyis dang*/ /sems dang de dag gi mtshan nyid/ /sems kyi rjes 'jug dus dang ni/

/'bras sogs dge la sogs pa'o/ /zhes byung*/ 'di la mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ sems kyi rjes 'jug ngos bzung*/ de rjes su 'jug tshul bzhi/ dang po ni/ lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu gang chos can/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid dam ngo bo yod de/ phan tshun phan 'dogs rgyu 'bras su gnas pa'i rgyu de de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de chos can/ khyod kyi mtshan gzhi dang dpe yod de/ tshogs pa gcig la gnas pa'i 'byung bzhi bzhin dang*/ sems kyi rjes 'jug nga brgyad dang sems bzhin dang*/ mtshan nyid skye sogs bzhi dang mtshan gzhi 'du byed pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sems kyi rjes 'jug chos can/ ngos bzung du yod de/ sems kyi 'khor du gyur pa'i sems byung rnams dang*/ bsam gtan zag med kyi sdom pa rnam pa gnyis dang*/ sems dang de dag gi mtshan nyid skye 'jig sogs de yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ sems kyi rjes 'jug de rnams chos can/ rgyu bcus sems kyi rjes 'jug ces bya ste/ dus kyi sgo nas bzhi dang 'bras bu sogs te rnam smin dang rgyu mthun gsum dang*/ dge ba sogs te mi dge pa lung ma bstan gsum dang bcu po gang rung yin par cig car rjes su 'jug pa gcig dgos pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ sems dang de'i skye 'gag sogs bzhi dus gcig pa dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ 'bras bu byed 'bras dang bral 'bras gnyis dang*/ rnam smin dang rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu rnams gang rung 'byung ba gcig dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ dge sogs gsum po gang yin pa gcig dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sems dge sogs gsum gyis rang rang gi sems byung dge sogs gsum so sor skyed par byed pa'i phyir/ lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras ni bye smra ltar na rgyu 'bras mtshan nyid pa yin kyang*/ gong ma rnams kyis btags pa bar bzhed de/ dus mnyam la rgyu 'bras mi bzhed pa'i phyir/gsum pa skal mnyam gyi rgyu la/

ngo bo spyir bstan pa dang*/ nang tshan bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ skal mnyam rgyu ni 'dra ba'o/ /zhes byung*/ skal mnyam gyi rgyu chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ 'bras bu rang dang rigs 'dra ba zhig skyed pa'i sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ dper na/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum gyi snga mas rang gi rigs 'dra phyi ram skyed par byed pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa la/ nyon mongs can dang*/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang ris sa pa'o sngar skyes rnams/ zhes byung*/ nyon mongs can gyi skal mnyam gyi rgyu chos can/ khyad chos gsum dang ldan te/ rang dang spang bya rigs gcig pa/ sa gcig pa/ 'bras bu'i sngar skyes pa gsum rnams dgos pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ mthong spang dang sgom spang lta bur rigs gcig pa dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ khams gsum po rang rang gi sa ma bsdus pa'i nyon mongs kyis rang rang gi las bsdus kyi nyon mongs phyi ma'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu byed kyi/ 'dod pa'i mthong spangs lta bus gong ma'i mthong spang gi rgyu mi byed pa sogs yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ 'bras bu de'i sngar skyes pas phyi ma skyes pa dang ma skyes pa'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu byed kyi/ dus mnyam pas de mi byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sa dgu'i lam ni phan tshun du/ /mnyam dang khyad par can gyi yin/ /sbyor byung de gnyis kho na'i yin/ /thos dang bsam byung la sogs pa/ /zhes byung*/ gong du sa gcig pa zhig dgos par bshad pa ni nyon mongs can gyi skal mnyam gyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ zag med la ni de ltar ma nges te/ zag med kyi sa dgu la brten pa'i lam ni phan tshun mnyam pas mnyam pa dang*/ khyad par can gyi rgyu byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ lam bden phan tshun mtho dman mnyam pa dang gong ma'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu byed pa'i phyir/ der ma zad sbyor byung 'jig rten pa'i lam zag bcas kyi dge ba de'ang mnyam pa dang khyad par can gyi skal mnyam gyi rgyu de gnyis kho na byed pa yin te/

thos byung dang bsam byung la sogs pa ste bsgoms byung rnams kyis de ltar byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi bsgoms byung med kyang thos byung dang bsam byung snga mas phyi ma'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu byed/ gzugs ni bsam byung med kyang thos byung dang bsgoms byung snga mas phyi ma'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu byed/ gzugs med du bsgoms byung snga mas phyi ma'i rgyu de byed pa'i phyir/ 'dir bsgoms byung 'jog mtshams yod de/ zhi gnas thob pa nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa mtshungs ldan rgyu ni/ mtshungs ldan rgyu ni sems dag dang*/ /sems byung rten mtshungs can rnams so/ /zhes byung*/ mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu chos can/ khyod 'jog tshul yod de/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen gcig la brten par mtshungs pa can gyi sems dag dang*/ sems byung rnams phan tshun rgyu 'bras su 'jog pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de dag phan tshun gcig med na cig mi 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras yin pa'i phyir/ 'di rgyu 'bras mtshan nyid par bye smras 'dod kyang gzhan gyis btags pa bar 'dod do/ /lnga pa kun 'gro'i rgyu ni/ kun 'gro zhes bya nyon mongs can/ /rnams kyi rang sa kun 'gro lnga/ zhes byung*/ kun 'gro'i rgyu chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ rang dang rigs dang sa gcig pa'i nyon mongs dang nyon mongs can gyi kun 'gro'i rgyu dang*/ de mi gcig pa'i nyon mongs dang nyon mongs can rnams kyi kun 'gro'i rgyu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ kun 'gro lnga yod de/ tshor 'du sogs lnga la byed pa'i phyir/ drug pa rnam smin gyi rgyu ni/ rnam smin rgyu ni mi dge dang*/ /dge ba zag bcas rnams kho na/ zhes byung*/ rnam smin gyi rgyu chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ rnam par smin pa 'byin byed kyi mi dge ba dang*/ dge ba zag bcas rnams kho na der 'jog pa'i phyir/ de gnyis chos can/ rnam smin gyi rgyu yin te/

ngo bo stobs dang ldan zhing sred pa'i rlan dang bcas pa'i phyir/ lung ma bstan rnams chos can/ rnam smin gyi rgyu ma yin te/ sred pa'i rlan dang bcas kyang ngo bo stobs dang mi ldan pa'i phyir/ dge ba zag med rnams chos can/ rnam smin gyi rgyu ma yin te/ ngo bo stobs dang ldan kyang sred pa'i rlan dang ma bcas pa'i phyir/ rnam smin gyi don yang yod de/ rnam par te khyad par mi 'dra bar smin pa de de'i sgra don yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa don bsdu ni/ kun 'gro skal mnyam dus gnyis pa/ /gsum po dag ni dus gsum pa/ /zhes byung*/ kun 'gro dang skal mnyam gyi rgyu chos can/ dus gnyis pa can yin te/ 'das pas da ltar ba dang*/ da ltar bas ma 'ongs pa'i rgyu byed pa can yin pa'i phyir/ lhan cig 'byung ba mtshungs ldan rnam smin gyi rgyu gsum po dag ni chos can/ dus gsum pa can yin te/ 'das pa dang da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pas khyad ma 'ongs pa skyed pa'i phyir/ 'dir spyi don gyis cung zad bshad na/ spyir rgyu drug gi nang tshan mi 'gal te/ rgyu yin na byed rgyu yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gzhi dang sbyar na 'gal ba mang ste/ rnam smin skyes kyi sems de'i rnam smin gyi rgyu yin na/ sems de'i mtshungs ldan dang lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu min dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu dang lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu ni de dang dus mnyam yin la/ de'i rnam smin gyi rgyu ni snga rol tu byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ de'i kun 'gro dang skal mnyam gyi rgyu gang rung yang sems de'i lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu min te/ de gnyis rang gi 'bras bu'i sngon du 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu la/ mtshan gzhi/ 'bras bu gang rgyu las skyes pa/ 'bras bu so so'i ngo bo dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'dus byas bral bcas 'bras bu yin/ /'dus ma byas la de dag med/ /ces byung*/

'bras bu chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ 'dus byas rnams dang*/ thal ba 'gog bden bcas de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dus ma byas chos can/ khyod la skyed byed kyi rgyu 'bras mtshan nyid ba de dag gang yang med de/ rgyu drug 'bras bu lnga'i byed rgyu dang bral 'bras ma gtogs gzhan skyed byed kyi rgyu 'bras mtshan nyid pa med pa'i phyir/ gal te 'dus ma byas la skyed byed kyi rgyu 'bras mtshan nyid pa yod de/ byed rgyu la 'dus ma byas yod cing bral 'bras 'dus ma byas yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ bral 'bras lam bden gyi stobs kyis thob kyang de lam bden las byung ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam smin 'bras bu tha ma'i yin/ /bdag po'i 'bras bu dang ba'i yin/ /rgyu mthun skal mnyam kun 'gro ba'i/ /skyes bu pa ni gnyis kyi yin/ /zhes byung*/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu chos can/ khyod kyi rgyu yod de/ rgyu drug gi tha ma rnam smin gyi rgyu las byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ bdag po'i 'bras bu chos can/ khyod kyi rgyu yod de/ rgyu dang po byed rgyu las byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu chos can/ rgyu gnyis kyi 'bras bu yin te/ skal mnyam dang kun 'gro'i rgyu las byung ba'i phyir/ skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu chos can/ khyod kyi rgyu yod de/ lhan cig 'byung ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu gnyis las byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rnam smin lung du ma bstan chos/ sems can brjod lung bstan phyis 'byung*/ /rgyu mthun rgyu dang 'dra ba'o/ /bral ba blo yis zad pa'o/ /gang gis stobs kyis gang skyes pa/ /zas de skyes bu byed las skyes/ /sngon byung ma yin 'dus byas ni/ /'dus byas kho na'i bdag po'i 'bras/ /zhes byung*/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu chos can/ khyod kyi chos gsum las dang po yod de/ mi dge ba dang dge ba gang rung ma yin zhing ma bsgribs lung du ma bstan pa'i chos yin pa zhig yin pa'i phyir mi dge ba yin te/

dgra bcom pa'i rgyud la yod pa'i phyir/ dge ba min te/ dge rtsa bcad pa la'ang yod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ 'bras bu rnam smin mi 'byin pa'i zag bcas yin pa'i phyir/ de'i chos gnyis pa yod de/ sems can du brjod pa rgyud kyis bsdus pa zhig yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ rang rgyu lung du bstan pa zag bcas kyi dge mi dge gang rung las phyis 'byung ba zhig yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ rang rgyu dang ris 'dra ba'i 'bras bu zhig la byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang rgyu skal mnyam gyi rgyu dang kun 'gro'i rgyu las byung ba'i phyir/ bral ba'i 'bras bu chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ blo bar chad med lam gyi stobs kyis rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya zad par spangs pa'i 'gog bden la 'jog pa'i phyir/ skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu chos can/ khyod kyi ngo bo bzhag tu yod de/ rgyu gang gi stobs kyis 'bras bu gang skyes pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'gog bden skyes bu byed 'bras yin la/ zhing pas bsgrubs pa'i lo tog dang*/ bzo bos byas pa'i khang pa dang*/ rnam grol lam rnams dang*/ zag bcas kyis zag med bskyed pa rnams dang*/ sa mi gcig pa'i nyon mongs can gcig las gcig skyes pa sogs de yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ bdag po'i 'bras bu yod de/ rgyu de'i sngon du byung ba ma yin pa'i 'dus byas rgyu de'i bdag po'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ bdag 'bras la 'dus ma byas yod dam zhe na med de/ 'dus byas kho na'i steng nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ skyes bu byed 'bras dang bdag 'bras gnyis mi 'gal te/ rgyu byed pa po dang lhan cig dang de ma thag byung ba'i 'bras bu de de gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa rgyu 'bras gnyis ka'i thun mong gi chos la/ 'bras bu 'dzin 'byin gyi khyad par dang*/ 'bras bu gang rgyu du zhig gis skyed pa gnyis/

dang po ni/ lnga po da ltar 'bras bu 'dzin/ gnyis ni rab tu 'byin pa yin/ /da ltar gyi dang 'das pa dag /gcig ni 'das pa 'byin par 'gyur/ /zhes byung*/ byed rgyu ma gtogs pa'i rgyu lnga po chos can/ da ltar ba'i 'bras bu 'dzin pa yin te/ 'das pas bzung zin nas 'das/ ma 'ongs pa la byed 'bras med pas 'dzin pa'i nus pa med pa'i phyir/ lhan cig 'byung ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu gnyis kyi chos can/ 'bras bu rab tu ste rgyud ltar ba dang dus mnyam du dang po nas 'byin par byed de/ 'bras bu 'dzin 'byin gnyis cig car da ltar gyi dus su mnyam du byed pa'i phyir/ skal mnyam dang kun 'gro'i rgyu gnyis chos can/ da lta ba rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu dang 'das pa'i rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu gnyis dag 'byin pa yod de/ skad cig gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i 'bras bu 'byin na da ltar gyi dus su de 'byin pa dang*/ bar chod pa'i 'bras bu 'byin na 'das pa'i dus su de 'byin pa'i bya ba byed pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu 'dzin zhes pa'i don yod de/ rgyal sras ma las/ 'dzin zhes bya ba ni 'phen par byed pa ste/ sa bon gyi dngos po nye bar gnas zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu 'dzin la mi 'byin pa yang yod de/ dge rtsa chad kha'i chung ngu'i chung ngu lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ 'dzin 'byin gnyis ka yin pa yod de/ dge rtsa ma chad pa'i skabs phal cher de yin pa'i phyir/ rnam smin gyi rgyu gcig pu ni chos can/ khyod 'das pa kho nas 'bras bu 'byin pa yin te/ lhan cig gam de ma thag khyod kyi 'bras bu 'byung ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ mtshungs ldan rgyu du las byung ba dang*/ mtshungs ldan min pa rgyu du las byung ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyon mongs can dang rnam smin skyes/ /lhag dang dang po 'phags rim bzhin/ /rnam smin kun 'gro de gnyis dang*/ /skal mnyam ma gtogs lhag las skyes/

/sems dang sems las byung ba yin/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ skabs 'dir chos bzhi yod de/ nyon mongs can dang rnam smin skyes dang*/ zag med dang po dang*/ de gsum gyi lhag ma'i 'dus byas dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ rim pa bzhin nyon mongs can chos can/ rgyu lnga las skyes te/ rnam smin gyi rgyu ma gtogs gzhan lnga las skyes pa'i phyir/ rnam smin las skyes pa chos can/ rgyu lnga las skyes te/ kun 'gro ma gtogs lhag ma lnga las skyes pa'i phyir/ lung ma bstan rnams dang zag med skad cig gnyis pa phan chad kyi dge ba rnams chos can/ rgyu bzhi las skyes te/ rnam smin gyi rgyu dang kun 'gro'i rgyu gnyis ma gtogs lhag ma bzhi las skyes pa'i phyir/ zag med skad cig dang po 'phags pa'i lam ni chos can/ rgyu gsum las skyes te/ rnam smin gyi rgyu kun 'gro rgyu skal mnyam gyi rgyu ma gtogs/ lhag ma byed lhan mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu gsum las skyes pa'i phyir/ chos bzhi po de dag 'dus byas spyir ma zad gtso bor mtshungs ldan gyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ sems dang sems byung gi dbang du byas pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mtshungs ldan ma gtogs gzhan de bzhin/ /zhes byung*/ mtshungs ldan ma gtogs pa'i 'bras bu chos can/ khyod kyi rgyu la du ma yod de/ sngar bshad pa de bzhin du bzhi dang gsum dang gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzhan sdom min dang dbang po nyon mongs can dang nyon mongs can gyi ldan min sogs ni rnam smin dang mtshungs ldan ma gtogs pa'i rgyu bzhi las skyes/ so thar dang bsam gtan la sogs pa'i dge ba ldan min dang skye 'jig sogs kyi lung ma bstan rnams ni/ rnam smin kun 'gro mtshungs ldan ma gtogs pa gzhan gsum las skyes/ zag med kyi sdom pa lta bu ni byed rgyu dang lhan cig gi rgyu gnyis las skyes pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu las ma byung ste/
