ldan min yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rkyen bye brag tu bshad pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ de ma thag rkyen bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dbye ba mdor bstan pa dang*/ so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa/ de dag gi khyad chos gzhan bshad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ rkyen ni bzhi po dag tu gsungs/ /zhes byung*/ rkyen chos can/ khyod la dbye na bzhi yod de/ rgyu rkyen dmigs rkyen bdag rkyen de ma thag rkyen dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyu zhes bya ba rgyu lnga yin/ /sems dang sems byung skyes pa rnams/ /tha ma min mtshungs de ma thag /dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad do/ /byed rgyu zhes bya bdag por bshad/ /ces byung*/ rgyu dang rkyen gnyis 'gal lam zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ byed rgyu ma gtogs pa'i rgyu zhes bya ba lnga po de rgyu'i rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ sems dang sems byung skyes pa phal che ba rnams chos can/ mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen yin te/ rang gi mtshungs pa de ma thag shes pa phyi ma skyed pa'i rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom pa'i tha ma'i sems sems byung rnams chos can/ mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen min te/ nyer 'bras rig pa phyi ma med pa'i phyir/ gzugs sogs kyi chos thams cad chos can/ dmigs pa'i rkyen dngos btags gang rung yin te/ gzugs mig gi rnam shes kyi dmigs rkyen yin pa nas chos thams cad yid kyi rnam shes kyi dmigs rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ bdag po rkyen chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ byed rgyu zhes bya ba de khyod du bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dir spyi don gyis cung zad bshad na/ spyir rgyu rkyen gnyis mi 'gal te/ de gnyis yin khyab mnyam yin pa'i phyir/ gzhi gcig la ltos na khyad par yod de/ chos de'i nyer len ni rgyu rkyen gnyis su phye ba'i rgyu yin la/ de'i lhan cig byed pa ni de gnyis su phye ba'i rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas ma yin pa'i chos ni/

dmigs rkyen dngos gnas par 'dod par mi bya ste/ de rkyen ma yin pa'i phyir/ bye smras nyon mongs can gyi sems phyi ma kho na'i de ma thag rkyen byed pa po sogs su 'dod kyang slob dpon ni de mi bzhed de/ zag bcas kyi sems sems byung gis ni/ zag med kyi sems sems byung gi de ma thag byed par bzhed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sbyor lam gyis mthong lam gyi de ma thag byed pa'i tshul sogs bzhed pa'i phy-ir/ gzugs can la mtshungs pa de ma thag med de/ de dang mtshungs ldan med pa'i phyir/ de ma thag rkyen yin na/ mtshungs pa de ma thag yin bas ma khyab ste/ de la mu bzhi bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyid 'thug po dang 'gog pa dang 'du shes med pa las langs ma thag pa'i dbang shes kyi de ma thag rkyen la 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' re snang ste/ mkhas pa kha cig ni gnyid dang snyoms 'jug las lang kha ma'i yid shes la 'dod cing*/ gzhan dag de ngag tu 'jug kha ma'i dbang shes la 'dod pa'i phyir/ byed rgyu rnams bdag rkyen du bshad pas rgyu yin na spyir bdag rkyen yin pas khyab la/ bdag rkyen zhes pa'i sgra don yod de/ mang po'i rkyen dang lhag pa'i rkyen zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ rkyen gang gis 'bras bu gang la bya ba byed tshul/ 'bras bu gang rkyen gang las byung tshul/ 'byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur gnyis rkyen dang rkyen can du 'gyur tshul gsum/ dang po ni/ rgyu gnyis po dag 'gag pa la/ bya ba byed po gsum po ni/ /skye la 'o de las gzhan pa yi/ /rkyen dag de las bzlog pa yin/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ rgyu lngas 'bras bu dus gsum po gang la bya ba byed tshul yod de/ ldan mtshungs gnyis po dag gis 'bras bu 'gag pa mngon du phyogs pa la bya ba byed/ skal kun rnam smin gsum po yis ni skye ba la mngon du phyogs pa ma 'ongs pa la bye ba byed pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/

de gnyis kyis 'bras bu da lta ba dus mnyam pa 'dzin 'byin gnyis dang longs spyod pa'i bya ba gsum byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ de gsum gyis 'bras bu ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba kho na la bya ba byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang 'bras 'phangs pa'i rjes su skye ba'i phyir/ de las gzhan pa yi rkyen de ma thag rkyen dmigs rkyen bdag rkyen gsum po dag ni chos can/ rkyen lnga po gnyis su bshad pa de las go rim bzlog nas byed pa yin te/ mtshungs rkyen gyis skye ba'i go skabs 'byed pas ma 'ongs pa la bya ba byed/ dmigs rkyen gyis da lta byung ba 'dzin pas 'gag bzhin pa la bya ba byed/ bdag rkyen gyis skye 'gag thams cad la bya ba byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bzhi yis sems dang sems byung rnams/ /gsum gyis skoms par 'jug pa gnyis/ /gzhan ni gnyis po dag las skye/ /dbang phyug sogs min rim sogs phyir/ /zhes byung*/ sems dang sems byung rnams chos can/ rkyen bzhi las skyes pa yin te/ rang gi rgyu rkyen dang bdag rkyen las skye ba gang zhig /dmigs rkyen dang de ma thag rkyen las kyang skye/ de bzhi ma tshang bar khyod skye ba med pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bzhi yis sems dang sems byung rnams/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'du shes med pa dang 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa gnyis chos can/ rkyen gsum las skye ste/ rgyu rkyen dang bdag rkyen dang de ma thag rkyen gsum las skye ba'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ skal mnyam las skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ lhan cig 'byung rgyu snga ma las skye ba'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ snyoms par 'jug kha ma'i sems dang bcas pa las skye ba'i phyir/ chos gzhan mtshungs ldan min pa'i 'du byed dang gzugs can rnams ni chos can/ rkyen gnyis las skye ste/

rgyu rkyen dang bdag rkyen gnyis po dag las skye ba'i phyir/ rkyen la rnam pa bzhi nges te/ phyi rol pas 'dod pa ltar dbang phyug rtag pa sogs te rang bzhin rtag pa dang*/ dus rtag pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid dang*/ rdul phran rtag pa sogs rkyen du mi rung ba'i phyir/ der thal/ 'bras bu rnams rim gyis skye ba'i phyir dang*/ sogs pas res 'ga' skye ba'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ 'byung ba rgyur byas pa dang*/ 'byung gyur rgyur byas pa gnyis/ dang po la/ 'byung ba skyed pa dang*/ 'byung 'gyur skyed pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de'i rgyu 'byung ba rnam pa gnyis/ zhes byung*/ 'byung ba de'i rgyu 'byung ba chos can/ rnam pa gnyis su yod de/ lhan cig byed pa dang skal mnyam gyi rgyu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'byung bas rang dang dus mnyam pa'i 'byung ba gzhan skyed pas lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu dang*/ 'byung bas rigs 'dra phyi ma'i 'byung ba skyed pas skal mnyam gyi rgyu byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'byung las gyur pa'i rnam pa lnga/ zhes byung*/ 'byung ba chos can/ khyod kyis 'byung ba las gyur pa'i rgyu rnam pa lnga byed de/ de skyed pa'i rgyu dang gnas pa'i rgyu dang rten pa'i rgyu dang mi chad pa dang 'phel ba'i rgyu lnga/ byed pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de las 'byung gyur skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ 'byung ba de 'byung gyur 'phel 'grib kyi gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ de 'byung gyur gyi rten yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma gnyis grub ste/ des 'byung gyur rgyun mi chad pa dang gong 'phel du byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'byung gyur las rang nyid skye ba dang*/ 'byung ba skyed pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'byung gyur rnam gsum phan tshun du/ zhes byung*/ 'byung gyur chos can/ khyod kyis 'byung gyur gzhan gyi rgyu gsum byed de/ lhan cig skal mnyam rnam smin gyi rgyu gsum byed pa'i phyir/

der thal/ bsam gtan dang zag med kyi sdom pa dang tshogs pa gcig pa rnams ni phan tshun lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras dang*/ 'byung gyur snga mas phyi ma'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu dang*/ mi dge ba dang dge ba las ngan song dang mtho ris kyi dbang lus rnams 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'byung ba rnams kyi de rnams gcig /zhes byung*/ 'byung 'gyur de rnams chos can/ khyod kyis 'byung ba rnams kyi rnam smin gyi rgyu gcig pu byed de/ tshe 'di'i lus ngag gi rnam par rig byed las phyi ma'i rnam smin skyes kyi mig sogs dbang po'i tshogs pa na yod pa'i 'byung ba'i rgyu byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de ma thag rkyen la/ bcu gnyis su dbye ba/ nyi shur dbye ba/ bcu gnyis po gang las gang gsar du rnyed tshul gsum/ dang po la/ dbye ba dngos dang*/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen dang rkyen can sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod yid dge dang mi dge dang*/ /bsgrib pa dang ni ma bsgribs pa/ /gzugs dang gzugs med pa dag na/ /mi dge las gzhan zag med gnyis/ /zhes byung*/ sems sam yid chos can/ /bcu gnyis yod de/ 'dod pa na yid dge ba dang mi dge ba dang*/ bsgribs lung ma bstan dang*/ ma bsgribs lung ma bstan dang bzhi/ gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams dag na mi dge ba las gzhan pa'i dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi sems gsum gsum ste drug dang*/ slob mi slob kyi zag med kyi sems gnyis dang bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs dang*/ gzugs med dang*/ zag med kyi dbang du byas pa bzhi/ dang po ni/ 'dod sems dge ba las sems dgu /de ni brgyad po kho na las/ /mi dge ba ni bcu dag las/ /de las bzhi ste bsgribs de bzhin/ /ma bsgribs pa ni lnga dag las/ /de las 'jug thogs sems bdun no/ /zhes byung*/ rtsa bar 'di dag gi skabs su sgrib ma sgrib gnyis kyi yi ge la bas phul sa'i mtha' rten 'byung yang don la khyad mi snang bas 'dir spyi ltar de dag med par byas te bshad na/

'dod pa'i dge ba'i sems chos can/ de ma thag rkyain gyi dbang du byas tshe khyod kyi mjug thog de ma thag las sems dgu 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun dang sa mtshungs kyi sgo nas rang sa'i bzhi nyid mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe gong ma'i sgrib lung ma bstan gnyis/ snyoms 'jug gi tshe gzugs kyi dge ba gcig /slob mi slob kyi zag med gnyis dang dgu 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ rgyun gyi tshe 'dod pa'i dge sems gcig dang sa mtshungs kyi mi dge ba dang lta ba gang rung dang mtshungs ldan gyi sgrib lung ma bstan dang rang sa'i spyod lam nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i lung ma bstan dang bzhi 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ gzugs dang gzugs med gang rung du skyo na de gnyis kyi nyon mongs can gang rung dang bcas sgrib lung ma bstan gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ 'dod pa'i dge ba sbyor byung gi mjug tu bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi gang rung gcig 'byung ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa grub ste/ 'dod pa'i slob mi slob kyi dge sems kyi mjug tu slob mi slob kyi sems zag med gnyis 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i dge sems de ni chos can/ sems brgyad po kho na'i mjug tu 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun dang sa mtshungs kyi tshe sngar ltar rang sa'i bzhi dang snyoms 'jug las lding ba'i tshe gzugs kyi dge sems gcig dang*/ slob mi slob kyi sems zag med gnyis dang*/ nyon mongs kyis gzir ba'i tshe gzugs kyi sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems te brgyad 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ mi dge ba ni chos can/ khyod bcu dag las 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun sa'i bzhi dang*/ nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe gzugs dang gzugs med kyi sems gsum gsum ste drug las 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ mi dge ba chos can/ khyod las bzhi 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun sa'i bzhi 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/

'dod pa'i sgrib lung ma bstan ni de bzhin du bcu las dang de bzhi las 'byung ba yod de/ sngar ltar yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i ma sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems chos can/ khyod sems lnga'i de ma thag tu 'byung ba yod de/ rang sa'i bzhi dang sprul pa la 'jug pa'i tshe gzugs kyi dge sems dag las 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi las mjug thogs su sems bdun 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun dang sa mtshungs kyi tshe ni/ khams gong ma gnyis su nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe de gnyis kyi nyon mongs can gnyis dang*/ sprul sems las ldang ba'i tshe gzugs kyi dge sems gcig dang bdun 'byung ba'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ gzugs na dge ba bcu gcig go /de ni dgu yi mjug thogs su/ /bsgribs pa brgyad de de las drug /ma bsgribs pa ni gsum las so/ /de las drug ste zhes byung*/ gzugs kyi dge ba'i sems chos can/ khyod las bcu gcig 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun sa'i tshe rang sa'i dge lta lung ma bstan gsum/ ldang ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i dge ba/ sprul 'jug gi tshe 'dod pa'i ma sgrib pa/ nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i mi dge ba dang sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems dang*/ gzugs med kyi sgrib lung ma bstan sems/ snyoms 'jug gi tshe gzugs med kyi dge ba dang zag med kyi sems gnyis dang bcu gcig yod pa'i phyir/ de ni chos can/ khyod sems dgu'i mjug thogs su 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun sa'i tshe rang sa'i gsum/ snyoms 'jug gi tshe 'dod pa'i dge sems/ ldang pa'i tshe gzugs med kyi dge ba dang zag med gnyis/ sprul ldang gi tshe 'dod pa'i ma sgrib pa/ nyon mongs can gyis gzer ba'i tshe gzugs med kyi sgrib pa las 'byung ba'i phyir/ gzugs kyi sgrib lung ma bstan gyi sems chos can/ sems brgyad las 'byung ste/ rgyun mtshungs kyi tshe rang sa'i gsum/ nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i tshe gzugs med kyi gsum/

/'dod pa'i dge ba dang ma sgrib pa'i sems gnyis las 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod las sems drug 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun mtshungs kyi rang sa'i gsum dang*/ nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i mi dge ba dang sgrib pa gnyis/ nyon mongs kyis gzir ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i dge ba ste drug 'byung ba'i phyir/ gzugs kyi ma sgrib pa'i sems chos can/ gsum las 'byung ste/ rang sa'i gsum las 'byung ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod las drug 'byung ste/ rang sa'i gsum dang*/ nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i mi dge ba dang sgrib lung ma bstan gnyis dang gzugs med kyi nyon mongs can te drug 'byung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gzugs med pa'ang*/ de yi tshul lo dge ba las/ / sems dgu dag gi de drug gi /bsgribs pa las bdun de de bzhin/ /zhes byung*/ gzugs med kyi ma sgrib pa'ang gzugs kyi de yi tshul ltar yin te/ de rang sa'i gsum las 'byung zhing de las rang sa'i gsum dang*/ nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i tshe gzugs kyi gcig dang*/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs can gnyis dang drug 'byung ba'i phyir/ gzugs med kyi dge ba chos can/ khyod las sems dgu dag 'byung ste/ rgyun dang sa mtshungs kyi tshe rang sa'i gsum/ nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i tshe gzugs kyi sgrib pa/ 'dod pa'i sgrib pa dang mi dge ba gnyis/ snyoms 'jug gi zag med gnyis/ de las langs pa'i tshe gzugs kyi dge ba dang dgu 'byung ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod drug gi mjug du 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun sa'i gsum dang*/ snyoms 'jug gi tshe gzugs kyi dge ba dang*/ de las ldang ba'i zag med gnyis te drug las 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs med kyi sgrib pa'i sems chos can/ khyod las bdun 'byung ba yod de/ sa mtshungs kyi tshe rang sa'i gsum/ nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i tshe gzugs dang 'dod pa'i sgrib pa gnyis/ mi dge ba dang snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can gyis gzir ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i dge rnams 'byung ba'i phyir/

de chos can/ snga ma de bzhin du bdun gyi mjug tu 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun sa'i gsum dang*/ nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i tshe 'dod gzugs kyi dge ba gnyis/ ma sgrib lung ma bstan bdun las 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ slob pa bzhi las de las lnga/ /mi slob pa ni lnga las so/ /de las sems ni bzhi dag go /zhes byung*/ slob pa'i zag med kyi sems de chos can/ khyod bzhi las 'byung ba yod de/ rgyun gyi tshe slob pa'i sems sngon ma dang*/ snyoms 'jug gi tshe khams gsum gyi dge ba gsum las 'byung ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi mjug thogs las sems lnga 'byung ste/ mnyam bzhag dang ldang ba'i tshe dang khams gsum gyi dge sems gsum dang slob pa'i rigs 'dra phyi ma dang mi slob pa'i zag med rnams 'byung ba'i phyir/ mi slob pa'i sems chos can/ khyod sems lnga'i mjug de ma thag las 'byung ba yod de/ snyoms 'jug gi tshe khams gsum gyi dge ba gsum/ slob pa'i rgyun phyi ma dang slob pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i sems rnams las 'byung ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod las sems bzhi dag 'byung ste/ rgyun gyi tshe mi slob pa'i sems phyi ma dang snyoms 'jug gi tshe khams gsum gyi dge ba gsum 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa bcu gnyis po nyi shur dbye ba ni/ bcu gnyis de dag nyi shur yang*/ /gsum du skyes nas thob pa dang*/ /sbyor byung dge rnam gnyis phye nas/ /rnam smin skyes dang spyod lam pa/ /bzo ba'i gnas dang sprul pa dang*/ /'dod na lung bstan min rnam bzhir/ /gzugs na bzo ma gtogs pa'o/ /zhes byung*/ bcu gnyis po de dag la dbye na sems nyi shur yang yod de/ khams gsum gyi dge ba la skyes nas thob pa dang sbyor byung gi thob pa rnam pa gnyis gnyis su phye nas drug dang*/ 'dod pa na lung bstan ma bstan gyi sems la rnam smin skyes dang*/ spyod lam pa dang*/ bzo ba'i gnas dang*/

sprul pa'i sems dang rnam pa bzhir phye/ gzugs na bzo'i las ni ma gtogs pa'i rnam smin skyes sogs gsum phye bas 'dod gzugs na lung ma bstan gyi sems bdun dang*/ gzugs med na ma sgrib lung ma bstan gy-i sems rnam smin gcig pu dang*/ slob mi slob kyi zag med kyi sems gnyis dang nyi shur yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs khams na bzo byed pa med de/ gnas khang gos sogs dang bcas rdzogs par skye bas de rnams bya mi dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sems kyi thob pa rnyed tshul bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ khams gsum pa yi nyon mongs can/ /drug dang drug dang gnyis rnyed de/ /gzugs skyes dge la gsum dag go /slob pa la bzhi lhag la de/ /zhes byung*/ sems de rnams las sems du zhig rnyed pa'i tshul yod de/ khams gsum pa'i sems nyon mongs can las 'dod pa'i nyon mongs can mngon du gyur pa'i sems drug gsar du rnyed/ gzugs kyi de mngon du gyur pa'i tshe sems drug gsar du rnyed/ gzugs med kyi de mngon du gyur pa'i tshe sems gnyis gsar du rnyed pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ 'dod gzugs nas 'dod par skyes pa'i tshe sems nyon mongs can gnyis dang dge ba skyes nas thob pa dang*/ 'dod nyon gyis dgra bcom nyams pa'i tshe gong ma gnyis kyi nyon mongs can gnyis dang slob pa'i sems rnams gsar du rnyed pa yod pa'i phy-ir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ gzugs med nas gzugs su skyes pa'i tshe gzugs kyi nyon mongs can dang dge ba la skyes thob dang*/ 'dod gzugs kyi sprul sems gnyis dang*/ gzugs kyi nyon mongs can gyis dgra bcom nyams pa'i tshe gzugs kyi nyon mongs dang slob pa'i lam rnams gsar du rnyed pa yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ gzugs med kyi nyon mongs pas dgra bcom nyams pa'i tshe de'i nyon mongs can gyi sems dang slob pa'i sems gnyis gsar du rnyed pa yod pa'i phyir/
